paper.title: Swift-Image: Exploring the Performance Frontier of Compact Unified Image Generation Models
paper.abstract: We present Swift-Image, a compact unified model for text-to-image generation, single-image editing, and multi-image editing. Our goal is to explore how far a relatively small visual generator can be pushed through systematic training engineering under a constrained computational budget. Swift-Image adopts an efficient 6B single-stream DiT and a progressive training pipeline that evolves from broad semantic coverage to higher resolution, stronger visual quality, and unified generation-editing sup

summary.core_problem: 在受限计算预算下，探索一个相对紧凑的统一图像生成模型能否同时做好文生图、单图编辑和多图编辑。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是工程型方法组合：把紧凑 DiT、渐进式训练、多目标后训练、prompt 改写、剪枝和少步蒸馏放在同一套图像生成系统里，关注小模型在统一生成任务上的性能边界。
summary.technical_approach: Swift-Image 使用 6B single-stream DiT 作为基础生成器，训练流程从宽语义覆盖逐步过渡到高分辨率、高视觉质量和统一生成-编辑监督。后训练阶段采用并行 expert reinforcement learning，再用 multi-teacher on-policy distillation 缓解不同目标之间的干扰。系统还加入 Prompt Enhancer，把用户请求改写成更适合生成器的视觉规格；部署侧通过结构化剪枝和少步蒸馏得到 3B 和加速版本。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到 6B 主模型、3B 剪枝版本和加速变体，覆盖文本到图像、单图编辑、多图编辑等任务，并声称在聚合指标上达到领先表现。具体训练数据规模、baseline 列表和提升幅度未在给定摘要中完整披露。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how far a compact unified image generator can be pushed for text-to-image generation, single-image editing, and multi-image editing under a constrained compute budget.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mostly an integrated engineering recipe: compact DiT design, progressive training, multi-objective post-training, prompt rewriting, pruning, and few-step distillation for a unified image generation system.
summary_en.technical_approach: Swift-Image uses an efficient 6B single-stream DiT. The training pipeline progresses from broad semantic coverage to higher resolution, stronger visual quality, and unified generation-editing supervision. Post-training combines parallel expert reinforcement learning with multi-teacher on-policy distillation to reduce interference across heterogeneous objectives. A Prompt Enhancer maps user requests into generator-aligned visual specifications, while structural pruning and few-step distillation produce 3B and faster variants.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a 6B main model, a 3B pruned variant, and accelerated versions, evaluated on text-to-image, single-image editing, and multi-image editing. It claims leading aggregate performance, but the provided abstract does not expose the exact data scale, baselines, or improvement numbers.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 的价值主要在多目标后训练和小 DiT recipe；扫训练管线即可，别把图像榜单当范式信号。
recommendation.en: Useful mainly for its compact-DiT training and multi-objective post-training recipe; skim the pipeline, not the image-generation leaderboard claims.

paper.title: From Corpora to Co-Evolving Capabilities: Capability-Centric Data Design for Generalist Image Generation
paper.abstract: Large-scale image generation has benefited from advances in data scale, quality, rebalancing, and recaptioning, yet conventional pipelines typically optimize task-specific datasets in isolation. A central challenge is not only how to curate each task-specific corpus, but also how to organize heterogeneous supervision according to the dependencies among generative capabilities. We present a \textbf{capability-driven data infrastructure} that couples capability-specific supervision construction wi

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“如何再堆更多图像数据”，而是更难也更接近基座训练的问题：当一个通用图像生成模型同时需要学会 T2I、图像编辑、知识关联、文本渲染、结构化生成等多种能力时，训练数据应该如何按能力依赖关系来组织，而不是按任务孤立构建。作者认为，传统数据管线把 image-caption、editing pairs、知识图文样本分别优化，忽略了能力之间的前置关系和可迁移性，导致监督重复、覆盖低效、课程顺序不合理。论文的核心问题，就是如何把 heterogeneous supervision 重新组织成一个 capability-centric 的数据基础设施，让不同能力沿着依赖顺序共同生长。
summary.importance: 这篇工作与预训练研究的相关性明显高于一般图像生成数据论文，因为它讨论的不是单一数据集质量，而是数据组织原则、能力分解、课程调度和主动回流修正。这些问题与 LLM 预训练里的 data mixture、curriculum、mid-train / continual training、能力导向采样非常接近。它的贡献更偏系统设计和数据方法学，而不是单个算法模块。量级上，如果全文实验扎实，这类工作对多模态基座训练的启发会比“再做一次 recaptioning”更大：它提出的是一种把数据视为能力图谱而非样本池的训练观。
summary.technical_approach:
技术方案由两部分组成：capability-specific data pipeline 和 capability-aligned curriculum scheduling。

先看数据管线。作者没有把所有样本混成一个大池子统一清洗，而是设计了三个可互操作的数据引擎。

第一是 T2I data engine，目标是建立广覆盖的 text-image grounding。全文提到它会做概念覆盖扩展、长尾重平衡、多粒度 caption 对齐，以及 dense caption 构造。这里的关键不是单纯提高 caption 质量，而是让 T2I 数据承担“概念底座”的角色，为后续结构化生成、文本渲染和编辑提供可迁移的视觉词汇与语义对齐。

第二是 image-editing data engine。作者把编辑监督视为多种操作类型的组合，因此不是只收集 source-target pairs，而是为不同编辑类型设计专门构造流程，同时从自然相关图像中挖掘真实关联，并用专家生成样本补足稀缺编辑类型。更重要的是，编辑指令在词汇和描述结构上与 T2I caption 对齐，这样编辑任务可以复用 T2I 已学到的概念表示，而不必在编辑数据里重复覆盖全部视觉概念。

第三是 knowledge-grounded data engine。它通过知识图谱引导的数据获取，把视觉模式与命名实体、结构化知识关联起来。这个设计针对的是一般图像生成模型常见的知识薄弱问题：模型能画出“像某物”的图，但未必能稳定绑定实体、属性和关系。

再看课程调度。作者提出五阶段 curriculum，沿能力依赖顺序逐步扩展训练混合。起点是大规模 T2I，用来建立基础视觉语义对齐和基本生成先验；随后加入结构复杂、知识相关、文本密集的样本，发展结构构图、知识绑定和文本渲染；在 T2I prior 稳定后，再引入 editing data，学习 reference preservation 和 controlled transformation；之后通过 continual training 与 SFT，把 mixture 转向更小、更平衡、更精细的数据子集，并让图像分辨率随内容复杂度提升。这里有四个共同演化轴：任务组成、视觉概念分布、数据质量、图像分辨率。

全文里另一个值得注意的点是 active refinement loop。课程不是一次性写死，而是通过 capability-aware evaluation 把失败模式映射回对应数据引擎，做 targeted retrieval、expert construction、resampling，再把修正后的数据重新注入后续训练。这使它更像一个闭环数据系统，而不是静态配方。

与常见做法相比，这篇工作的区别不在于某个过滤器或 captioner 更强，而在于它把“数据样本”提升为“能力单元”，把“任务数据集”改写成“可迁移监督源”。
summary.experiments:
题面给出的全文片段主要覆盖引言，缺少完整实验表格和具体数字，因此不能虚构参数量、样本规模或精确提升幅度。能从全文叙述中明确提炼出的实验主线有三条。

第一，作者应当评估 capability-specific engines 的独立贡献与互补性，也就是 T2I、editing、knowledge-grounded 三类监督分别带来什么能力增益，以及联合训练是否优于把任务数据孤立构建后直接混合。若实验设计完整，最值得看的是：文本渲染、知识绑定、复杂结构生成、编辑保持度这几类能力是否出现明显迁移收益。

第二，作者强调 curriculum 的依赖顺序，因此实验里大概率会比较 capability-aligned schedule 与固定混合、随机混合、任务独立训练等基线。这里真正重要的不是最终单点分数，而是训练收敛速度、能力出现顺序，以及后期加入 editing / CT / SFT 后是否更稳定。

第三，active refinement loop 应该会通过 failure-driven data augmentation 或 targeted resampling 展示闭环收益。若论文给出案例，建议重点看哪些失败能通过回流修正，哪些失败则说明能力分解仍不充分。

从研究判断看，这篇工作的实验价值主要在“组织原则是否成立”。如果结果只是常规地证明更多高质量数据更好，那信息量有限；如果它能证明按能力依赖组织数据，比按任务堆数据更高效、更可迁移，那就有更强的方法学意义。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓住两个问题：作者如何定义 capability，以及这些 capability 之间的依赖关系是否有可操作的证据。Introduction 里关于 T2I 先于 editing、简单内容先于复杂结构、概念覆盖可跨任务迁移的论证，是理解整篇文章的入口。

接着看三个 data engine 的具体构造。重点不是数据量，而是每个引擎负责补哪类监督缺口、如何与其他引擎共享视觉词汇和标注规范。若正文有示意图或案例表，优先看这些，因为它们最能说明“specialized yet interoperable”到底怎么落地。

然后看五阶段 curriculum 和 active refinement loop。建议留意四个演化轴——任务组成、概念分布、质量、分辨率——是否真的联动，而不是口头描述。若有训练曲线或阶段切换实验，这部分最值得看。

最后看评测设计。若评测只是常规图像生成指标，阅读收益会下降；若作者构造了 capability-aware evaluation，把失败模式映射回数据引擎，那部分更有方法学价值。作为 skim 级阅读，30 到 40 分钟可以抓住主线；若你做多模态预训练数据系统，建议把数据引擎定义、课程表和失败回流机制一起细读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not asking how to simply collect more image data. It asks a more foundational question: when training a generalist image generator that must acquire text-to-image generation, image editing, knowledge grounding, text rendering, and structured composition, how should data be organized according to capability dependencies rather than task silos? The authors argue that conventional pipelines optimize image-caption data, editing pairs, and knowledge-linked samples largely in isolation, which ignores transfer structure between capabilities and leads to redundant supervision and weak curricula. The core problem is how to build a capability-centric data infrastructure so that heterogeneous supervision supports co-evolving capabilities instead of fragmented tasks.
summary_en.importance: This is more relevant to pretraining research than a typical image-generation data paper because it is about data organization principles, capability decomposition, curriculum scheduling, and feedback-driven refinement. Those questions are close to LLM concerns such as data mixture design, curriculum, continual pretraining, and capability-targeted sampling. The contribution is mainly methodological and infrastructural rather than a single algorithmic trick. If the experimental evidence is strong, the paper matters because it treats data as a capability graph rather than a flat sample pool, which is a useful lens for multimodal foundation-model training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The framework has two main parts: a capability-specific data pipeline and a capability-aligned curriculum schedule.

On the data side, the authors build three specialized but interoperable engines instead of throwing all samples into one global pool.

The first is a T2I data engine for broad text-image grounding. It expands concept coverage, rebalances long-tail distributions, aligns captions at multiple granularities, and uses dense captions where needed. The important design choice is that T2I data is treated as the conceptual base layer. It is not only for standalone text-to-image quality; it is meant to provide reusable visual vocabulary and semantic alignment for later capabilities such as structured generation, text rendering, and editing.

The second is an image-editing data engine. Rather than collecting generic source-target pairs only, the paper describes specialized pipelines for different edit types, mining realistic associations from naturally related images, and using expert-generated examples for sparse edit categories. A key interoperability choice is that editing instructions are aligned with T2I captions in vocabulary and descriptive structure. This allows editing supervision to reuse concepts already learned from T2I data instead of duplicating full concept coverage inside editing datasets.

The third is a knowledge-grounded data engine. It links visual patterns to named entities and structured knowledge through knowledge-graph-guided acquisition. This targets a common weakness in image generators: they may produce plausible imagery without reliably binding entities, attributes, and relations.

On the curriculum side, the paper proposes a five-stage schedule that follows the dependency order of capability acquisition. Training starts with large-scale T2I data to establish broad visual-semantic alignment and a basic generative prior. It then adds structurally complex, knowledge-grounded, and text-rich examples to develop composition, knowledge grounding, and text rendering. Once the T2I prior is stable, editing data is introduced to learn reference preservation and controlled transformation. Later continual training and supervised fine-tuning shift the mixture toward smaller, more balanced, and more refined subsets, while image resolution increases with content complexity. The schedule evolves jointly along four axes: task composition, visual concept distribution, data quality, and image resolution.

A notable systems idea is the active refinement loop. The schedule is not fixed once and for all. Capability-aware evaluation maps observed failures back to the relevant data engine, which then performs targeted retrieval, expert construction, or resampling. The refined data is fed back into later training mixtures. This makes the proposal a closed-loop data system rather than a static recipe.

Compared with standard data-pipeline work, the novelty is not a better filter or captioner in isolation. The novelty is the shift from task datasets to transferable supervision sources organized around capability dependencies.
summary_en.experiments:
The provided full-text excerpt is mostly from the introduction, so it does not expose the full result tables or exact numbers. It would be unsafe to invent model sizes, corpus sizes, or precise gains. Still, the experimental logic is clear from the paper’s framing.

First, the paper should test the independent and complementary value of the three data engines. The key question is whether T2I, editing, and knowledge-grounded supervision each improve distinct capabilities, and whether joint capability-oriented training is better than simply mixing task-specific datasets built in isolation. The most informative outcomes would be gains in text rendering, knowledge binding, complex composition, and edit faithfulness.

Second, because the paper emphasizes dependency-aware curriculum, an important comparison is likely between the proposed staged schedule and baselines such as fixed mixtures, random mixtures, or task-isolated training. What matters here is not only final quality but also convergence speed, emergence order of capabilities, and stability after introducing editing, continual training, and SFT.

Third, the active refinement loop should be evaluated through failure-driven data augmentation or targeted resampling. If the paper includes case studies, the useful question is which failure modes can be repaired by routing them back to the right data engine, and which ones reveal that the capability decomposition is still incomplete.

The real value of the experiments is whether they validate the organizational principle. If the results only show that more curated data helps, the contribution is limited. If they show that organizing data by capability dependencies is more sample-efficient or more transferable than organizing by task silos, the paper becomes much more interesting.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with how the paper defines capabilities and the dependency structure between them. The argument that T2I grounding should precede editing, and that simpler content should precede complex structure, is the conceptual entry point.

Then read the sections describing the three data engines. Focus less on raw scale and more on what supervision gap each engine fills, and how annotation conventions and visual vocabulary are shared across engines. Any diagrams or concrete examples are likely more informative than high-level prose.

Next, read the five-stage curriculum and the active refinement loop. Pay attention to whether the four evolving axes—task composition, concept distribution, quality, and resolution—are actually operationalized rather than described abstractly. Training curves or stage-transition ablations would be especially useful.

Finally, inspect the evaluation design. If the evaluation is only standard image-generation benchmarking, the methodological value is lower. If the paper includes capability-aware evaluation that maps failures back to data engines, that is the part worth studying carefully. For a skim-level read, 30 to 40 minutes should be enough. If you work on multimodal pretraining data systems, the data-engine definitions, curriculum schedule, and failure-feedback loop deserve a closer read.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是 LLM，但它把 data mixture 从“按任务拼盘”改成“按能力依赖调度”，这个 prior 值得迁到多模态和 reasoning pretrain；先看数据引擎设计和 curriculum 章节。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but it reframes data mixture from task buckets to capability dependency scheduling; that prior is worth porting to multimodal and reasoning pretraining. Read the data-engine and curriculum sections first.

paper.title: XYZFlow:Scaling Multi dimensional Shortcut Flows for Efficient Generative Modeling
paper.abstract: High-fidelity image generation faces a trade-off between speed and quality. Diffusion models produce strong visuals but require costly iterative sampling. Existing efficient methods mainly distill pretrained models into few-step samplers, a challenging process that depends heavily on teacher-model quality. In this paper, we introduce XYZFlow, a framework that rethinks efficient generation through multidimensional scaling of flow matching. Unlike single-step mappings, XYZFlow enhances expressivit

summary.core_problem: 在图像生成中缓解 diffusion/flow 模型采样步数多、少步生成质量下降的问题。
summary.importance: 这是生成模型方法创新，试图不用依赖 teacher distillation，而是通过 flow matching 的多维条件扩展提升少步生成能力。它对文本 LM 预训练不是直接贡献，但其中把 autoregressive modeling 解释为 implicit flow straightening 的视角，对统一 AR+diffusion 建模有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 XYZFlow，通过 temporal scaling 和 spatial scaling 两个维度增强 flow 的可辨识性和可学习性。Temporal scaling 使用完整去噪历史做 non-Markovian conditioning；spatial scaling 通过 Next Shortcut Prediction 顺序生成 patches，用已生成 patch 缩短后续轨迹的不确定性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据、baseline、采样步数、FID/IS 或人评结果。声称目标是高效高保真生成，并与依赖 pretrained teacher 的蒸馏方法形成对比，但定量可信度需看正文实验设置。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce the speed-quality trade-off in image generation, where diffusion and flow models often need many sampling steps for high fidelity.
summary_en.importance: This is a generative modeling method rather than an LLM pretraining paper. Its interesting part for foundation-model researchers is the attempt to improve few-step flow generation without teacher distillation, plus the framing of autoregressive modeling as implicit flow straightening.
summary_en.technical_approach: XYZFlow scales flow matching along two conditioning dimensions. Temporal scaling uses non-Markovian conditioning on the full denoising history, while spatial scaling uses Next Shortcut Prediction to generate patches sequentially and condition later patches on earlier ones.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training data, baselines, sampling steps, FID/IS, or human evaluation. The paper claims efficient high-fidelity generation and positions itself against teacher-dependent distillation, but the experimental setup must be checked in the full text.

recommendation.zh: 不必细读；若做 AR+diffusion 统一建模，可看它如何把上下文条件解释成 flow straightening。
recommendation.en: Do not read in full; if working on unified AR-diffusion modeling, inspect how it frames context conditioning as flow straightening.

paper.title: Diffusion Image Editing via Asynchronous Token Decoding
paper.abstract: Text-guided diffusion image editing aims to modify semantic attributes of an image while preserving its identity, layout, and background. However, naïvely switching the text condition during sampling often causes global drift, as denoising dynamics propagate changes across tokens and can disrupt unedited regions. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{A}synchronous \textbf{T}oken \textbf{D}ecoding \textbf{Edit} (ATDEdit), an inference-time framework that views each sampler step as a parallel

summary.core_problem: 解决文本引导 diffusion 图像编辑中目标文本条件会扩散到全局，导致未编辑区域身份、布局和背景漂移的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是训练-free 的图像编辑推理方法；对 LLM 预训练不是直接相关，但 token-wise 条件切换和局部更新策略对离散/连续生成过程的控制有一定参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ATDEdit，把每个 sampler step 视为对全局耦合 token 矩阵的并行更新，并允许按 token index 切换条件。方法用 token-wise conditional surprisal 估计可编辑位置，只对选中 token 施加目标条件修正；对保留 token 提供 source key/value memory，并把部分 latent row 投影回 source value，以减少未编辑区域漂移。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出使用的 diffusion backbone、数据集、编辑 benchmark、baseline 或具体提升幅度；目前只能判断为 inference-time editing framework。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses global drift in text-guided diffusion image editing, where switching the text condition during sampling can alter identity, layout, and background outside the intended edit region.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free image editing inference method. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but its token-wise condition switching and localized update policy may be useful for thinking about controlled generative dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: ATDEdit treats each sampler step as a parallel update of a globally coupled token matrix and enables token-indexed condition switching. It estimates editable locations using token-wise conditional surprisal, applies target-conditioned corrections only to selected tokens, supplies source key/value memory for keep-token positions, and projects selected latent rows back to source values.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the diffusion backbone, datasets, editing benchmarks, baselines, or numerical gains. It can only be assessed as an inference-time editing framework from the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 与 pretrain 关系弱，但 token 级异步条件切换值得扫一眼，可能给 diffusion-LM 控制采样一些类比。
recommendation.en: Weakly tied to pretraining, but the token-level asynchronous condition switch is worth a glance for analogies to controlled diffusion-LM sampling.

paper.title: DreOPD: Degraded-Reference Extrapolative On-Policy Distillation for Flow-matching Models
paper.abstract: Flow-matching models are now a mainstream method to image generation, but its adaptation to diverse downstream scenarios typically relies on post-training, which may cause conflicts among task-specific optimization objectives. Reinforcement learning enables direct optimization of task-specific rewards beyond the original models, yet trajectory-level optimization may incur high-variance gradients and cross-task interference. On-policy distillation (OPD) offers dense and stable supervision on stud

summary.core_problem: 流匹配模型下游任务后训练中，强化学习轨迹优化梯度方差高、任务间干扰，而传统on-policy蒸馏仅做模仿无法超越教师。
summary.importance: 流匹配生成模型后训练方向的方法创新，将奖励外推与on-policy蒸馏结合，提供更稳定的下游适配路径。
summary.technical_approach: 提出DreOPD，把隐式奖励外推转化为闭式速度回归，使外推式后训练具备OPD的稳定性；同时引入轻度退化参考以增强教师-参考对比，明确外推方向。
summary.experiments: 在图像生成任务上验证，摘要未给出完整基线和量化提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Post-training flow-matching models for downstream tasks suffers from high-variance gradients under RL trajectory optimization and cross-task interference, while conventional on-policy distillation only imitates and cannot exceed the teacher.
summary_en.importance: A method innovation in post-training for flow-matching generative models, combining reward extrapolation with on-policy distillation for more stable downstream adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes DreOPD, which converts implicit reward extrapolation into closed-form velocity regression, enabling extrapolative post-training with OPD-level stability; uses a mildly degraded reference to strengthen teacher-reference contrast and clarify extrapolation direction.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on image generation tasks; full baselines and quantitative improvement magnitudes not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 图像生成流匹配模型的后训练方法，与文本LLM预训练无直接关联，作为生成模型文献备查即可。
recommendation.en: Post-training method for image generation flow-matching models; no direct relevance to text LLM pretraining, useful only as generative model literature reference.

paper.title: Energy-Guided Flow Matching
paper.abstract: Pixel-space generative models bypass lossy latent compression, yet necessitate joint learning of global structure and fine-grained details in a high-dimensional space. Standard flow matching interpolates noise toward a fixed clean-image endpoint, leaving the spectral evolution to be learned implicitly. In this paper, we introduce Energy-Guided Flow Matching(EG-FM) that explicitly models a coarse-to-fine generative trajectory by moving endpoint. Specifically, EG-FM replaces the fixed endpoint wit

summary.core_problem: 解决 pixel-space flow matching 在高维图像空间中需要同时学习全局结构和细节纹理，频谱演化完全隐式、训练负担较重的问题。
summary.importance: 这是图像生成建模方法改进，贡献在于把 flow matching 的固定 clean endpoint 改成随时间释放高频信息的移动 endpoint；对文本 LLM 预训练不是直接相关，但对 flow/diffusion 生成轨迹设计有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Energy-Guided Flow Matching。方法用 heat-kernel-filtered endpoint 替代固定干净图像端点，使目标从低频图像平滑过渡到完整图像；高频释放比例由 image-specific energy-guided schedule 控制，从而重定向 velocity field。作者强调不需要改 backbone 或训练数据，训练和推理额外开销很小。
summary.experiments: 在 ImageNet 类条件图像生成上评估，摘要称 EG-FM 相比标准 flow matching 持续降低 FID；未给出具体 backbone、参数量、训练数据规模、baseline 列表和提升数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the difficulty of pixel-space flow matching, where the model must learn both global structure and fine details while spectral evolution is left implicit.
summary_en.importance: This is an image-generation modeling improvement. Its main contribution is replacing the fixed clean endpoint in flow matching with a moving endpoint that gradually releases high-frequency content. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but the trajectory-design idea is relevant to diffusion and flow-based generative modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Energy-Guided Flow Matching uses a heat-kernel-filtered endpoint instead of a fixed clean image endpoint. The endpoint evolves from a low-frequency version of the image to the clean image, and an image-specific energy-guided schedule controls how much high-frequency signal is released, thereby retargeting the velocity field. The method is presented as backbone- and data-agnostic with negligible extra cost.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on ImageNet class-conditional image generation, where the abstract reports consistently lower FID than standard flow matching. The abstract does not provide model size, training scale, exact baselines, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和 ImageNet FID 表即可；对离散 LM 没直接结论，但 endpoint 调度思路可借鉴。
recommendation.en: Skim the method figure and ImageNet FID table; it says little about discrete LMs, but the endpoint scheduling idea is reusable.

paper.title: UniWorld-Design: From Pixel Generation to Layer-Native Design
paper.abstract: We introduce UniWorld-Design, a framework that redefines image generation from flat pixel synthesis to structured visual composition, with semantic RGBA layers as the atomic units of generation, understanding, and editing. Our key insight is that pixels define how an image is rendered, whereas layers define how an image is created, understood, and edited. Just as human designers create and manipulate visual content through layers rather than raw pixels, UniWorld-Design equips multimodal generati

summary.core_problem: 现有图像生成模型以扁平像素为输出单元，缺乏结构化语义表示，难以支持可编辑、可分解的设计场景，不符合人类设计师的分层创作逻辑。
summary.importance: 范式创新（图像生成的输出范式从像素转向分层语义），提出层原生的图像生成框架，支持多种分层编辑操作。
summary.technical_approach: 提出UniWorld-Design框架，包含两个核心模型：1）Text-to-RGBA（T2RGBA）模型：直接从文本生成独立的RGBA语义资产层；2）Image-to-Layer（I2L）模型：以成品图像、全局指令和逐层提示为条件，联合生成有序、完整的语义RGBA层。支持顶层分解、递归分解、定向提取等指令化分层操作。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体实验设置、基线模型及量化效果，仅说明框架支持多种分层生成与编辑功能。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing image generation models output flat pixels, lacking structured semantic representation, which makes them unsuitable for editable, decomposable design scenarios and inconsistent with human designers' layer-based creation logic.
summary_en.importance: Paradigm innovation in image generation output (from pixels to layered semantics); proposes a layer-native image generation framework supporting various layered editing operations.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes UniWorld-Design with two core models: 1) Text-to-RGBA (T2RGBA) model, which generates standalone RGBA semantic asset layers directly from text; 2) Image-to-Layer (I2L) model, which takes a finished image, global instruction, and per-layer prompts as input to jointly produce ordered, complete semantic RGBA layers. Supports instruction-driven layering operations including top-level decomposition, recursive decomposition, and targeted extraction.
summary_en.experiments: Specific experimental setup, baselines, and quantitative results are not provided in the abstract; only the framework's supported layered generation and editing functions are described.

recommendation.zh: 图像生成的分层表示思路，对多模态预训练的视觉结构化表示设计有微弱参考，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Layered representation for image generation, a weak reference for structured visual representation design in multimodal pretraining; read abstract only.

paper.title: WaiT for the Signal: Simple Frequency-Aware Flow-Matching
paper.abstract: As image generation models scale to ever higher resolutions, global coherence, local detail, and texture fidelity become critical axes for generation quality. However, standard flow matching treats all spatial frequencies uniformly, ignoring the natural frequency hierarchy where high-frequency bands become indistinguishable from pure noise far earlier than coarse structures. We introduce WaiT, a Wavelet-aware image Transformer that decomposes generation into coarse and fine bands via lossless wa

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的问题很具体：标准 flow matching 在整条生成轨迹上对所有空间频率一视同仁，但图像里的低频结构和高频纹理并不等价。高频分量在较强噪声下会更早退化成近似纯噪声，模型如果从一开始就同时建模高低频，早期大量算力会花在几乎不可辨认的高频上，结果是全局结构建立阶段被干扰，采样也不够经济。作者把这个问题表述为“高频应该等到有信号时再进入生成过程”，核心是在不引入复杂多尺度架构的前提下，把频率层级直接写进 flow matching 的噪声日程里。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要有两层。第一，它说明生成目标本身可以带有结构化归纳偏置，不一定非要靠更复杂的 backbone 或 latent VAE 才能获得多尺度建模能力。这里用的是无损小波分解，把 coarse-to-fine 的先验直接放进训练和采样过程。第二，它对统一建模范式有参考价值：如果不同子空间的信噪比演化规律不同，就不该共享完全相同的 corruption / denoising schedule。这一点不只适用于图像，也可能迁移到视频、音频离散 token、甚至某些非 AR 语言建模范式。就量级看，这不是“换个指标的小修小补”，而是在 pixel-space flow matching 上给出了一种简单但有效的训练-采样改造，同时把评测也往更细粒度推进了一步。
summary.technical_approach:
方法的关键是把图像先做单层离散小波变换 DWT，拆成一个低频近似带和三个高频细节带。作者全程使用 Haar wavelet，因为它实现简单、正交、可逆，而且单层 2D Haar 在直觉上接近 2×2 average pooling 加残差信息存储。与 learned latent 不同，这个变换是无损的，不需要额外训练编码器。

在此基础上，作者没有设计双塔或金字塔网络，而是沿用 JiT 的 pixel-space transformer，只改噪声注入和采样日程。低频带在整个 t∈[0,1] 上参与 flow matching；高频带只在 t∈[t*,1] 上参与，也就是前半段保持纯噪声，等低频已经形成较稳定的粗结构后，再把高频噪声注入并与低频通过逆小波变换合并，随后联合去噪。这样做的含义很明确：早期模型只处理 coarse structure，后期再处理 fine detail，避免在低信噪比区间浪费容量。

从训练角度看，这相当于给不同频带定义不同的线性噪声日程。作者强调这不是把高频完全独立建模，而是“延迟进入、后期联合 refinement”，因此仍保留跨频带耦合。相比 latent diffusion，这个方案不需要 VAE 压缩带来的信息损失；相比标准 pixel-space flow matching，它显式利用了自然图像的频率层级；相比复杂 progressive 生成架构，它几乎不改主干网络，工程代价较低。

另一个值得注意的点是评测设计。作者认为标准 FID 会把高分辨率图像下采样到 299×299，天然忽略很多高频纹理，因此补充了 5-crop FID 用于原生分辨率局部结构评估，以及 high-frequency Fréchet Wavelet Distance，用来更直接地看纹理保真度。这个评测设计和方法本身是配套的，因为如果目标就是改善高频建模，只看 FID 很容易低估收益。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 ImageNet、OpenImages、text-to-image 和 video，重点结果比较完整。

在 ImageNet 512×512 上，作者报告 WaiT 达到 FID 1.43、5cFID 1.63、hFWD 0.67，并且相对 JiT baseline 最高可减少 50% 采样 GFLOPs。最大的 2B 模型在 ImageNet 512 上做到 pixel-space 模型里 1.3 的 FID。文中还强调，在 hFWD 这个纯纹理指标上，WaiT 超过了当时的 pixel-space 和 latent-space 方法，说明收益不只是全局结构更稳，而是高频细节确实更好。

在 OpenImages 的 512 和 1024 分辨率条件生成上，趋势一致，说明方法不是只对 ImageNet 这种相对规整的数据有效。迁移到 pixel-space text-to-image 1024×1024 时，作者称在几乎所有指标上持平或优于 JiT，同时吞吐最高可到 3 倍。再往视频扩展时，使用时空小波，Kinetics-600 上 FVD 达到 0.84。

从消融逻辑看，最值得注意的不是单个绝对数，而是几组机制验证：一是作者通过轨迹分析展示高频在早期时间步几乎不可辨认，支持“wait for the signal”的前提；二是不同 t* 设定体现了质量与速度的折中，说明延迟过早或过晚都不是最优；三是三轴指标之间并不完全一致，某些方法 FID 好但 hFWD 差，证明只看 FID 会漏掉纹理质量问题；四是人类偏好与 5cFID/hFWD 的相关性被用来支撑新评测的有效性。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但如果你关心非 AR 生成建模范式，建议至少把方法和评测部分看细一点。优先看 Introduction 和方法总览图，先建立“为什么高频要延迟”的直觉。然后看 Figure 3 一类的轨迹可视化，那里给出了高频在早期近似纯噪声的证据，这是整篇成立的前提。方法部分重点看 DWT 分解、双日程定义、以及推理时在 t* 注入高频噪声再联合去噪的流程。实验部分建议重点看 ImageNet 512 的主表、t* 或频带设计的消融、以及三轴评测和人类偏好的对应关系。预计 25 到 35 分钟可以抓住主要信息。

如果从预训练研究角度深挖，有两个点值得继续想。第一，频率分组只是一个特例，更一般的问题是：不同子空间是否应该共享同一 corruption schedule。第二，lossless transform + delayed denoising 这种思路，能否迁移到离散 token 或多模态统一生成里，用来处理不同模态、不同码本层级、不同语义粒度的信噪比不匹配。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific inefficiency in standard flow matching: it applies the same denoising schedule to all spatial frequencies, even though low-frequency structure and high-frequency detail behave very differently under noise. High-frequency components become indistinguishable from noise much earlier than coarse structure. As a result, a substantial part of the early trajectory is spent modeling HF bands that carry little usable signal, exactly when the model should be allocating capacity to global layout and coherence. The proposed fix is to let high frequencies “wait for the signal” rather than participate from the start.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining-oriented readers, the main value is not image generation performance alone. The paper shows that a generative objective can encode a useful structural prior directly in the corruption and denoising process, without relying on a more elaborate backbone or a learned latent autoencoder. That is a broader lesson: if different subspaces have different signal-to-noise dynamics, forcing them to share one schedule is likely suboptimal. This idea could matter beyond image FM, including video, audio token modeling, and alternative LM paradigms that move away from plain next-token AR. The contribution is meaningful because it changes both training/sampling behavior and evaluation, while keeping the architecture nearly unchanged.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method starts with a single-level discrete wavelet transform. An image is decomposed into one low-frequency approximation band and three high-frequency detail bands. The implementation uses the Haar wavelet throughout, mainly because it is orthogonal, invertible, simple, and effectively acts like a lossless 2×2 average-pooling-plus-residual decomposition. Unlike a learned latent space, this transform introduces no reconstruction loss and requires no extra encoder training.

The core change is not architectural. The model keeps the JiT pixel-space transformer and modifies the noise schedule. The LF band is trained over the full time interval t in [0,1], while the HF bands are only active over [t*,1]. During inference, the model first denoises the coarse band alone. At time t*, HF noise is injected, the bands are recombined through the inverse wavelet transform, and the model continues with joint refinement. This preserves cross-band interaction in the later stage, but avoids spending early trajectory steps on HF content that is effectively pure noise.

Conceptually, this is a frequency-aware flow-matching schedule. Compared with standard pixel-space FM, it explicitly respects the natural frequency hierarchy of images. Compared with latent diffusion, it obtains a coarse-to-fine decomposition without a lossy VAE bottleneck. Compared with progressive multi-scale architectures, it is much simpler and cheaper to integrate into an existing transformer pipeline.

A second contribution is the evaluation protocol. The authors argue that standard FID is too forgiving at high resolution because it downsamples to 299×299 and discards much of the fine detail. They therefore add 5-crop FID for native-resolution local structure and high-frequency Fréchet Wavelet Distance for texture fidelity. This matters because the method is explicitly designed to improve high-frequency generation; using only FID would hide part of the gain.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments span class-conditional image generation, text-to-image, and video. On ImageNet 512×512, WaiT reports FID 1.43, 5cFID 1.63, and hFWD 0.67, while reducing sampling GFLOPs by up to 50% relative to the JiT baseline. The largest 2B model reaches FID 1.3 on ImageNet 512 for pixel-space models. The paper also highlights that on hFWD, which isolates texture fidelity, WaiT outperforms both pixel-space and latent-space baselines, suggesting the gain is not limited to global structure.

The same trend appears on OpenImages at 512 and 1024 resolution, which is useful because it reduces the chance that the effect is ImageNet-specific. In pixel-space text-to-image at 1024×1024, the method matches or exceeds JiT on almost all metrics while reaching up to 3× higher throughput. With spatiotemporal wavelets, the recipe transfers to video and achieves FVD 0.84 on Kinetics-600.

The most informative evidence comes from the mechanism-oriented analyses. The trajectory visualizations show that HF bands remain nearly indistinguishable from noise early in sampling, which supports the central premise. Ablations around t* expose a quality-efficiency trade-off: delaying HF helps, but the exact delay matters. The three-axis evaluation also reveals disagreement between metrics, with some methods looking strong on FID but weaker on local detail or texture. That strengthens the case that standard FID alone is insufficient for high-resolution generation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim-level read, but it is worth reading the method and evaluation sections with some care if you work on non-AR generative modeling. Start with the introduction and the overview figure to internalize the main intuition: coarse structure should emerge before fine detail joins the denoising process. Then look at the trajectory analysis figure showing that HF content is effectively noise early on; that figure carries much of the paper’s motivation. In the method section, focus on the DWT decomposition, the two schedules, and the inference procedure that injects HF noise at t* before joint denoising. In experiments, prioritize the main ImageNet 512 table, the ablations on t* and band design, and the comparison between FID, 5cFID, hFWD, and human preference. Around 25–35 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas.

Two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind. First, frequency bands are only one example of heterogeneous subspaces; the broader issue is whether different parts of the representation should share one corruption schedule at all. Second, the combination of a lossless transform and delayed denoising may transfer to tokenized multimodal generation, where different codebooks or modalities also have mismatched signal-to-noise profiles.

recommendation.zh: 图像生成领域的频率感知流匹配创新，分阶段生成思路可迁移至文本diffusion/flow LM，仅看方法节即可。
recommendation.en: Frequency-aware flow matching innovation in image generation; the staged generation idea is transferable to text diffusion/flow LMs, just skim the method section.

paper.title: Argus-Unified: Towards A Compact and Economical Unified Model for Image Understanding and Generation
paper.abstract: Unifying visual understanding and generation in one model holds immense promise, but remains challenging and expensive due to heavy compute and data demands and conflicts between the visual features needed for these two capabilities. To address these challenges, we present Argus-Unified, a compact, effective and unified multimodal model built with low demand on computation and data. Instead of aligning modalities from scratch, Argus-Unified effectively leverages pretrained vision-language models

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是统一多模态模型里一个很具体、也很难绕开的矛盾：图像理解更依赖连续视觉特征，图像生成更依赖离散视觉 token，而现有统一模型通常要么把两者都压到离散 token 上，牺牲理解能力；要么为理解和生成各配一套视觉编码链路，带来额外参数和训练成本。Argus-Unified试图回答的是，能否直接站在已有 VLM 的视觉-语言对齐能力之上，用单一视觉编码器同时服务理解与生成，并把训练成本压到一个很低的量级。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的启发不在于它把统一多模态问题彻底做完，而在于它给出了一条更节制的路线：不要从头学图文对齐，也不要为了生成能力重建整套视觉前端，而是把预训练 VLM 当成强先验，在冻结视觉编码器的前提下补一个量化器和解码器，再做联合训练。这种思路和纯文本预训练里“尽量复用已有表征、把新增训练集中在接口层”的做法很接近。它的贡献量级更像是一个训练 recipe 和系统设计上的改进，而不是新的建模范式。对关心 multimodal pretrain、视觉 tokenizer、AR 统一建模的人有参考价值；对纯文本 LLM 预训练的直接外溢相对有限。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是“单编码器 + 混合视觉 token”。具体分两阶段。

第一阶段是 Unified Vision Tokenizer Training。作者从一个预训练 VLM 取出视觉编码器，并将其冻结。这个编码器继续输出适合理解任务的连续视觉 token。同时，在其上训练一个 quantizer，把连续特征离散化为生成侧可用的视觉 token；再训练一个 image decoder，用这些离散 token 做图像重建。这里一个关键取舍是：因为视觉编码器冻结，训练目标可以只用重建损失，不需要再做图文对齐。这和很多从头训练 UMM 的路线不同，后者往往要同时处理视觉表示学习、离散化和跨模态对齐，优化耦合更重。

第二阶段是 Unified Multimodal Training。作者不是从纯 LLM 初始化，而是直接从预训练 VLM 初始化语言模型及其图文接口，让模型继承已有的 vision-language priors。理解任务仍走连续 token 路径，生成任务则把图像表示映射为离散 token 序列，由同一个 AR 解码器统一建模。这样做的直接好处是：理解能力不必迁就生成 tokenization，生成能力也不需要第二个视觉编码器。

和已有路线相比，差异主要有三点。第一，区别于 Chameleon/Emu3/VILA-U 一类把理解和生成尽量压到统一离散 token 空间的方法，Argus-Unified保留了连续特征用于理解，因此更重视语义保真。第二，区别于 Janus 一类双视觉编码器设计，它坚持单编码器，优先控制参数量和训练成本。第三，区别于从 LLM 出发重新学图文对齐的统一模型，它直接复用 VLM 初始化，把训练难点从“学会对齐”转成“学会在已有对齐上接入生成分支”。

从预训练视角看，最值得注意的是它把视觉 tokenizer 训练从多目标联合优化里拆了出来，先把离散化接口单独学稳，再做统一多模态训练。这种分阶段接口学习，在多模态基座里通常比端到端硬训更省数据，也更稳。
summary.experiments:
实验结论很明确：在很小的模型和数据预算下，理解侧表现突出，生成侧达到可竞争水平。文中强调 Argus-Unified-0.5B 只使用约 0.5B 级别 LLM 主体、总训练数据约 15.6M、总训练成本约 2000 美元，却能在 GQA、POPE、VQAv2 等理解 benchmark 上超过一些 7B 级统一模型，如 Emu3 和 Chameleon，同时生成指标保持竞争力。

从论文给出的叙述看，关键证据主要来自以下几类对比：
1. 与从头对齐的统一模型比较，Argus-Unified在理解任务上更强，说明直接继承 VLM priors 确实减少了“生成训练拖累理解表征”的问题。
2. 与双编码器方法比较，在参数更紧凑的情况下维持了不错的生成质量，说明单编码器 + 量化器这条路并非只是省参数，也能保住足够的生成信息。
3. 数据和成本对比是作者反复强调的点：只用 15.6M 训练样本，明显低于很多使用数千万到数亿样本的统一模型。这意味着它更像“高效迁移已有多模态先验”，而不是“靠大规模再训练堆出来”。

按全文结构推测，消融重点应包括：是否冻结视觉编码器、是否从 VLM 而非 LLM 初始化、连续/离散 token 的不同组合、单编码器与双编码器的权衡、以及两阶段训练相对端到端训练的效果。真正值得看的不是单个 benchmark 分数，而是这些设计选择如何影响理解-生成 trade-off。如果论文表格中给出生成指标如 FID 或 GenEval 一类结果，建议结合理解指标一起看，因为这篇工作的价值就在于平衡，而不是单点最优。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合泛读，但有几个位置值得仔细看。

第一看 Introduction 和方法总览图，重点不是背景铺垫，而是 Fig.2/3 里四种路线的对比：统一离散 token、双编码器、以及作者的单编码器混合 token 方案。把这张图看明白，整篇文章的设计动机就基本清楚了。

第二看 Stage 1 的 tokenizer 训练细节。需要确认 quantizer 的形式、codebook 规模、重建目标、decoder 结构，以及冻结 encoder 后是否出现表征瓶颈。这部分决定它是不是一个可复用的视觉离散化接口，而不只是论文里的特定工程实现。

第三看 Stage 2 的训练目标和数据配比。要关注理解样本与生成样本如何混合、prompt 格式如何统一、图像 token 序列长度如何控制、是否有专门的 loss balancing。统一模型常见问题不是“能不能训起来”，而是某一侧任务把另一侧拖偏。

第四看消融表。优先关注 VLM 初始化 vs LLM 初始化、连续 token 对理解的贡献、单编码器 vs 双编码器、冻结 vs 微调视觉编码器。这些实验最能说明作者的核心判断是否站得住。

如果时间有限，30 到 40 分钟足够抓住主线。若要深挖，重点放在视觉 tokenizer 接口设计和训练分阶段策略，而不是 benchmark 罗列。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific bottleneck in unified multimodal modeling: image understanding prefers continuous visual features, while autoregressive image generation typically relies on discrete visual tokens. Existing unified models usually resolve this mismatch in one of two costly ways: either they force both tasks into a shared discrete token space and hurt understanding quality, or they use separate visual pathways for understanding and generation and pay extra parameter and training cost. Argus-Unified asks whether a pretrained VLM can be turned into a compact unified model with a single vision encoder that serves both purposes.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is not a new modeling paradigm, but a practical pretraining recipe for multimodal unification under tight compute and data budgets. The paper argues that one should reuse the multimodal priors already present in a pretrained VLM, freeze the vision encoder, learn a lightweight quantization interface for generation, and then jointly train the decoder for understanding and generation. That is a meaningful systems-level contribution for multimodal pretraining: it reduces the amount of alignment that must be relearned from scratch and isolates the tokenizer/interface problem from the full end-to-end optimization problem. The direct relevance to text-only LLM pretraining is limited, but the lessons around interface learning, staged training, and reuse of pretrained priors are useful.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core design is a single vision encoder with hybrid visual tokens. The model uses continuous tokens from a pretrained VLM encoder for understanding, and discrete tokens derived from the same encoder for generation.

Training is split into two stages.

Stage 1 is unified vision tokenizer training. The vision encoder from a pretrained VLM is frozen. On top of its continuous features, the authors train a quantizer to produce discrete visual tokens and an image decoder to reconstruct images. Because the encoder is frozen and already aligned with language through the original VLM, this stage can focus on image reconstruction rather than multimodal alignment. That is an important simplification compared with prior unified multimodal models that often need to jointly learn visual representation, tokenization, and cross-modal alignment.

Stage 2 is unified multimodal training. Instead of initializing from a plain LLM, the model is initialized from a pretrained VLM so that the language model and multimodal interface inherit existing vision-language priors. Understanding tasks consume continuous visual tokens. Generation tasks consume discrete visual tokens produced by the learned quantizer, and the same autoregressive decoder models them jointly with text.

Relative to prior work, the distinctions are clear. Compared with models that use discrete tokens for both understanding and generation, Argus-Unified preserves continuous semantic features for understanding. Compared with dual-encoder designs such as Janus-style systems, it keeps a single encoder and prioritizes compactness. Compared with unified models trained from an LLM backbone and aligned from scratch, it starts from a pretrained VLM and shifts the burden from alignment learning to generation interface learning.

From a pretraining perspective, the most interesting choice is the decomposition of the problem: first learn a stable visual discretization interface on top of frozen features, then perform joint multimodal training. That staged approach is often easier to optimize and more data-efficient than forcing everything into one end-to-end run.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline result is strong understanding performance under a very small budget, with generation quality remaining competitive. The paper reports that Argus-Unified-0.5B uses a roughly 0.5B-scale LLM backbone, only about 15.6M training samples, and an estimated total training cost of around $2,000, yet surpasses some 7B-scale unified models such as Emu3 and Chameleon on understanding benchmarks including GQA, POPE, and VQAv2.

The most important empirical claims appear to be:
1. Better multimodal understanding than unified models that rely on discrete tokens more heavily, suggesting that preserving continuous features matters.
2. Competitive generation quality despite using a single vision encoder, which supports the claim that the quantizer-plus-decoder interface is sufficient for generation without a separate generation encoder.
3. A much smaller data and compute footprint than many prior unified multimodal systems, which is central to the paper’s positioning.

The ablations worth paying attention to are likely the following: VLM initialization versus plain LLM initialization, frozen versus trainable vision encoder, continuous versus discrete token choices for understanding, single-encoder versus dual-encoder design, and two-stage training versus more entangled alternatives. For this paper, the key question is not whether one benchmark number is highest, but whether the design improves the understanding-generation trade-off in a stable and economical way.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, but a few parts deserve careful attention.

Start with the introduction figures that compare the design space: shared discrete tokens, dual encoders, and the proposed hybrid-token single-encoder setup. Those diagrams carry most of the paper’s motivation.

Then read the Stage 1 tokenizer section closely. Check what kind of quantizer is used, how large the codebook is, what reconstruction losses are applied, and whether freezing the encoder creates a bottleneck. This determines whether the learned tokenizer is a reusable interface or just a task-specific engineering choice.

Next, inspect the Stage 2 training setup: how understanding and generation data are mixed, how prompts are formatted, how long the visual token sequences are, and whether there is explicit loss balancing. Unified models often fail because one side of the objective dominates the other.

Finally, focus on the ablation tables rather than the benchmark sweep. The most informative comparisons are VLM init versus LLM init, continuous-token understanding versus discrete-token understanding, and single versus dual encoder. Around 30 to 40 minutes should be enough to extract the main ideas.

recommendation.zh: 混合连续/离散 token 的思路对统一多模态预训练有参考，但属于工程组合，读 §3 方法和主表即可。
recommendation.en: The hybrid continuous/discrete token idea is a useful data point for unified multimodal pretraining, but it is mostly engineering composition; read §3 and the main table.

paper.title: Show, Don't Tell: Evaluating Spatial Cognition in Generative Pixels Rather Than LLM Text
paper.abstract: Spatial intelligence is essential for agents to move from static semantic understanding toward interacting with the physical world. Many spatial tasks are grounded in continuous visual scenes, where locations, regions, and paths are more naturally expressed by pointing, marking, or drawing than by reporting precise coordinates or discrete textual symbols. Yet existing spatial reasoning benchmarks usually require coordinates, options, or text, creating an answer-interface mismatch for image-gener

summary.core_problem: 现有空间推理评测几乎都假设模型用“文本/坐标/选项”作答，导致对图像生成模型（以像素为原生输出）的空间能力评测出现严重的 answer-interface mismatch：模型可能能“画出来/标出来”，但基准无法用原任务指标计分，也难以与文本输出 VLM 在同一语义任务下可控对比。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对“统一多模态生成范式（AR+diffusion/原生图像生成）如何被公平评测”有现实影响：如果评测接口不匹配，训练信号与模型选择会系统性偏向文本输出范式，间接影响多模态预训练路线的目标设计与数据构造。更具体的启发在于：把生成式模型的输出约束为可解析协议（protocolized output），用解析器回到结构化指标空间，能减少对 VLM-judge 的依赖与不确定性。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 ProVisE（Protocolized Visual Evaluation）框架：
1) 以“视觉协议”替代文本/坐标答案接口：要求图像生成模型在输出图像中以预定义格式表达答案（例如用特定颜色/形状标注区域、画路径、指向目标等），使输出天然落在像素空间但满足可解析约束。
2) 解析器把协议化图像输出转换为结构化预测（如 bbox/mask/路径点/方向标签等），从而复用原空间任务的标准指标，实现与文本输出 VLM 的 metric-compatible 对比。
3) 讨论手工为每个任务设计协议不可扩展，因此提供“Agentic construction path”：用代理式流程自动构造/选择协议与解析步骤（全文在引言处点到，细节需看方法章节）。
与常见替代方案的差异：
- 不走“VLM judge 读图给答案”的路线，避免把评测误差与 judge 能力耦合；
- 不把任务改写成文本多选/坐标回归，而是让生成模型用其擅长的像素表达，同时仍回到原任务指标。
summary.experiments:
给出的全文片段主要是问题定义与框架动机，尚未包含可复述的关键数字、模型清单、协议类型覆盖范围、解析鲁棒性统计、以及与 judge-based 评测的一致性/方差对比等结果细节。若论文后续章节提供：
- 不同协议在同一任务上的可解析率（parse success rate）与指标方差；
- 生成模型与文本 VLM 在同一任务语义下的可比性实验；
- 解析器误差对最终分数的敏感性分析；
这些会是判断其工程可落地性的关键证据。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 重点看 Figure 1（interface mismatch 的具体例子）以及方法章节对“协议约束 + 解析回结构化指标”的定义：协议如何设计、允许哪些自由度、如何防止模型钻协议空子。
- 优先找两类实验：①与 VLM-judge 方案的对照（相关性、方差、失败模式）；②跨任务/跨协议的可扩展性（是否每个任务都要重写大量规则）。
- 如果关心对预训练的启发，重点看作者是否讨论“把协议化输出作为训练目标/中间监督”的可能性，以及它与 unified multimodal generation（如 AR+diffusion）训练接口的关系。

summary_en.core_problem: Spatial reasoning benchmarks typically force answers into text, coordinates, or discrete options. This creates a severe answer-interface mismatch for image generation models whose native output is pixels: they may be able to externalize spatial judgments by drawing/marking, but the benchmark cannot score those outputs with the original task metrics, making controlled comparison with text-output VLMs unreliable.
summary_en.importance: Limited direct impact on pretraining recipes, but it matters for how multimodal generative paradigms (native image generators, AR+diffusion unified models) are evaluated and therefore selected and optimized. The key idea—constraining generative outputs into a parseable protocol and mapping them back to structured predictions—reduces dependence on VLM-as-a-judge and can make evaluation signals less model-dependent and less noisy.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ProVisE (Protocolized Visual Evaluation) proposes:
1) Protocol-constrained visual answers: the generator must express the answer in a predefined visual format (e.g., specific markers, highlights, trajectories) rather than text/coordinates.
2) A task-specific parser converts the generated image into structured outputs compatible with the benchmark’s original metrics (bbox/mask/path/labels), enabling metric-compatible evaluation.
3) Since hand-crafting protocols per task does not scale, an agentic construction pipeline is introduced to help build protocols/parsers (the provided excerpt signals this; details should be in the methods section).
Compared to common workarounds:
- It avoids judge-based scoring where a separate VLM interprets the generated image, which entangles evaluation with judge reliability.
- It avoids rewriting tasks into unnatural symbolic interfaces that disadvantage pixel-native models.
summary_en.experiments:
The provided full-text excerpt is largely motivation and framing; it does not include reproducible quantitative results (models, datasets, protocol coverage, parse success rates, robustness, or correlations vs judge-based evaluation). The most decision-critical evidence to look for in later sections is:
- Parse success rate and failure modes across protocols/tasks.
- Agreement/variance comparisons against VLM-judge baselines.
- Sensitivity of final scores to parser errors and protocol degrees of freedom.
- Cross-task scalability showing how much manual engineering is still required.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Start with Figure 1 to internalize the interface mismatch.
- Read the method section defining the protocol format and the parsing pipeline; check how they prevent loopholes and ensure unambiguous decoding.
- Jump to experiments that compare (a) protocol+parser scoring vs VLM-judge scoring, and (b) scalability across multiple spatial task types.
- If you care about pretraining implications, look for discussion on using protocolized visual outputs as training targets or intermediate supervision for unified multimodal generators.

recommendation.zh: 只看协议化像素答案解析；它可能影响统一生成模型的空间评测接口。
recommendation.en: Skim the protocol-constrained pixel parsing; it may matter for evaluating spatial reasoning in unified generative models.

paper.title: Mage-Flow: An Efficient Native-Resolution Foundation Model for Image Generation and Editing
paper.abstract: Large-scale visual generators are increasingly capable but costly to train, fine-tune, and deploy. We introduce Mage-Flow, a compact 4B-scale generative stack for efficient text-to-image generation and instruction-based image editing. The stack is built from two co-designed components: Mage-VAE, a lightweight high-fidelity latent tokenizer, and a Native-Resolution Multimodal Diffusion Transformer trained with rectified flow matching. Mage-VAE uses one-step diffusion-style encoding and decoding w

summary.core_problem: 大规模视觉生成模型训练/微调/部署成本高，需要紧凑高效且支持原生分辨率的生成栈。
summary.importance: 工程系统创新：4B 规模紧凑生成栈，在 tokenizer 和训练吞吐上做了实打实的系统优化（~2.5× 训练吞吐），并覆盖生成+编辑+RL 对齐+Turbo 全变体。
summary.technical_approach: Mage-VAE：一步扩散式编解码 + anchor-latent 正则，重建质量对标公开强 VAE 但 tokenization 成本降一个数量级；Native-Resolution Multimodal DiT 用 rectified flow matching，配合 native-resolution packing 和 CUDA kernel fusion 支持灵活分辨率训练。
summary.experiments: 4B 规模；Mage-VAE tokenization 成本降 >10×；端到端训练吞吐 ~2.5×；发布 Base/RL-aligned/Turbo 三个变体覆盖生成与编辑；摘要未给具体 FID/benchmark 数字。

summary_en.core_problem: Large-scale visual generators are costly to train, fine-tune, and deploy; a compact, efficient, native-resolution generative stack is needed.
summary_en.importance: Engineering/systems contribution: a compact 4B generative stack with concrete systems optimizations (~2.5× training throughput) and a full family covering generation, editing, RL alignment, and Turbo variants.
summary_en.technical_approach: Mage-VAE: one-step diffusion-style encoding/decoding with anchor-latent regularization, matching strong public VAEs in reconstruction while cutting tokenization cost by >10×; Native-Resolution Multimodal DiT trained with rectified flow matching, plus native-resolution packing and CUDA kernel fusion for flexible-resolution training.
summary_en.experiments: 4B-scale; tokenization cost reduced >10×; ~2.5× end-to-end training throughput; Base/RL-aligned/Turbo variants for generation and editing; no concrete FID/benchmark numbers in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 工程细节（anchor-latent VAE、native-resolution packing、kernel fusion）对做统一多模态 tokenizer+DiT 的人有参考，纯文本预训练可略过。
recommendation.en: Engineering details (anchor-latent VAE, native-resolution packing, kernel fusion) are useful if you build unified multimodal tokenizer+DiT stacks; text-only pretrain folks can skip.

paper.title: Appearance Pointers -- Multimodal Region Control of Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: Controllable image generation remains challenging for creative professionals, who often require precise regional control over materials, object identities, and spatial arrangements that cannot be reliably achieved through text prompting alone. Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) can natively ingest heterogeneous tokens stemming from texts and images, but they lack mechanisms for determining where and how these tokens should influence the output. We introduce appearance pointers, compact tokens that gu

summary.core_problem: 创意图像生成需要对局部区域的材质、身份和空间关系做精确控制，单靠文本提示很难稳定指定“哪个条件影响哪个区域”。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成控制方法。它针对 Diffusion Transformer 提出一种不重训基础模型的局部控制接口，对研究 DiT 如何接收异构 token、如何做区域级条件绑定有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 appearance pointers：把文本或图像条件与用户给定 mask 对齐，生成紧凑指针 token，用来告诉 DiT 在指定空间位置读取对应外观线索。指针由 region correspondence network 产生，再经 spatial aggregation 细化，从而支持多个区域描述，同时避免显著增加 token 数。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体数据集、模型规模和数值结果。实验应围绕区域级可控生成，对比纯文本提示、已有局部控制方法或额外适配器，验证多区域、多模态条件下的身份、材质和布局控制能力。

summary_en.core_problem: Creative image generation needs precise local control over materials, identities, and spatial layouts, which text prompts alone cannot reliably provide.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a controllable multimodal generation method. It proposes a localized conditioning interface for Diffusion Transformers without retraining the base model, which is relevant to how DiTs bind heterogeneous tokens to spatial regions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces appearance pointers: compact tokens that align text or image conditions with user-provided masks and tell the DiT which appearance cues should affect which spatial locations. A region correspondence network produces the pointers, and a spatial aggregation mechanism refines them to handle multiple regional descriptions without large token overhead.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not include datasets, model sizes, or quantitative results. The expected evaluation compares regional controllability against text-only prompting or prior local-control methods, focusing on identity, material, and layout preservation under multi-region multimodal conditions.

recommendation.zh: 对 LLM 预训练不是主线，但 DiT 条件 token 如何做空间绑定值得扫一下方法图。
recommendation.en: Not central to LLM pretraining, but the spatial binding of conditioning tokens in DiTs is worth a quick look at the method figure.

paper.title: Signed Rectified Flow: Negativity-Controlled Generation
paper.abstract: We introduce Signed Rectified Flow (Signed RF), a generalization of Rectified Flow that targets the signed measure $π^{sign} = (1+α)π^+ - απ^-$, where $α>0$, $π^+$ is the distribution to promote, and $π^-$ is the distribution to suppress. Although direct sampling from a signed measure is not well-defined, Signed RF induces a valid generative process that concentrates probability in regions where the signed measure is positive while provably excluding regions dominated by its negative component.

summary.core_problem: 解决生成模型如何显式利用“负信息”或排除约束的问题，即不仅学习要生成什么，也学习哪些区域应被压低或排除。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成建模方法创新。它把 Rectified Flow 从普通概率分布扩展到带正负成分的有符号测度，为负样本、禁区、去相似性和约束生成提供了一个较干净的数学接口。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Signed Rectified Flow，目标写成 πsign=(1+α)π+−απ−。虽然有符号测度不能直接采样，作者通过 signed continuity equation 构造有效生成动力学，使概率集中在正测度占优区域，并在负测度占优区域形成排斥屏障。论文还用带电粒子解释该机制，并据此设计 adaptive guidance 算法。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖若干图像生成相关应用，包括 ImageNet 上的 fidelity-diversity 权衡，以及降低最近邻相似度等场景。摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据细节和完整数值，只说明相较常规 Rectified Flow / guidance 设置有改进。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how a generative model can use negative information and exclusion constraints, learning not only what to generate but also which regions to suppress.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a generative modeling method. It extends Rectified Flow from ordinary probability measures to signed measures, giving negative examples and forbidden regions a more explicit mathematical role.
summary_en.technical_approach: Signed Rectified Flow targets πsign=(1+α)π+−απ−. Since a signed measure is not directly sampleable, the method defines a valid generative dynamics through a signed continuity equation, concentrating mass where the signed measure is positive and creating exclusion barriers where the negative component dominates. A charged-particle interpretation motivates practical adaptive guidance algorithms.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover image-generation applications, including ImageNet fidelity-diversity trade-offs and reducing nearest-neighbor similarity. The abstract does not provide model scale, training-data details, or full numeric results, but reports improvements over standard Rectified Flow or guidance-style baselines.

recommendation.zh: 和 LLM 预训练不直接相连，但 signed measure 作为负样本建模接口值得扫 abstract 和理论设定。
recommendation.en: Not directly an LLM pretraining paper, but the signed-measure interface for negative data is worth a quick look.

paper.title: Think, Plan, Paint: Layout-Aware Reasoning for Controllable Image Generation in Unified Models
paper.abstract: Unified Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) offer a promising paradigm for unifying visual understanding and generation, yet they still struggle to follow complex spatial instructions and logical constraints in controllable image generation. To address this gap, we present ATLAS, a unified framework that equips MLLMs with a human-like "Think, Plan, and Paint" paradigm. We adopt layout as the shared representation that connects the three stages, enabling the model to reason about spatial req

summary.core_problem: 统一式多模态大模型在“可控图像生成”里很难稳定遵循复杂空间指令与逻辑约束：一方面，布局（layout）往往被当作从文本直接回归出来的结果，缺少显式推理来分解对象、数量、相对关系，导致布局不完整或自相矛盾；另一方面，布局更多被当作生成阶段的辅助控制信号，而不是贯穿理解/规划/生成/编辑的共享空间表示，因而难以形成可解释、可编辑、可复用的空间接口。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不在“更强的图像生成指标”，而在于给统一建模（AR 文本 + 连续图像 latent 的 Transfusion-style）提供了一种可落地的中间表示与训练闭环：用离散的空间位置 token 把推理链、布局计划、生成对齐串起来，并在生成阶段引入 RL 信号去对齐“计划—渲染”的一致性。这类工作对跨模态统一预训练的启发点是：1）中间结构（layout）如果能被 token 化并在多任务间共享，就能把黑盒生成变成可监督、可诊断的过程；2）RL 不只用于对话对齐，也可以作为跨模态一致性约束的后期校准信号（plan-to-image fidelity）。整体更像是“统一模型的可控生成 recipe + 评测资产（ATLAS-Reasoning）”，而不是纯算法小改。
summary.technical_approach:
ATLAS 把生成流程拆成 Think / Plan / Paint 三段，并把 layout 提升为跨模态桥梁。
1）Shared Positional Tokens（共享位置 token）：把连续坐标离散到 1000 桶，分别用 <pos_x_k> 与 <pos_y_k> 组成统一空间词表 V_pos。每个对象用 (label, box) 表示，box 由四个位置 token（x1,y1,x2,y2）串成序列。关键点是：同一套位置 token 同时用于理解、规划、生成、编辑，使“空间”成为统一模型内部可复用的离散接口。
2）Think：引入 Layout-Aware CoT，让模型先在文本侧分解实体、数量、显式/隐式空间约束，再进入布局生成。这里的取舍是：不把布局当作 prompt→坐标的直接映射，而是把它当作可解释的推理产物；同时通过共享位置 token 把视觉先验（空间分布、相对位置常识）更自然地接入推理链。
3）Plan：在推理链 R 条件下生成布局序列 L={ (c_i,b_i) }。布局是显式中间状态，可用于后续编辑与诊断。
4）Paint：在 Transfusion-style 统一 AR backbone 上，把布局转成高保真图像 latent/像素生成。为提升“计划—渲染”一致性，引入 RL-based layout alignment：用强化学习信号直接优化生成结果与计划布局的对齐（论文动机是解决生成阶段对象偏移、漏画、错画等问题）。
5）Backbone 与规模：在两个统一 AR MLLM backbone（BAGEL 7B、Hunyuan Image 3.0 80B）上实现，强调方法对架构与规模的可迁移性。
summary.experiments:
论文在 7B 与 80B 两个尺度上验证可扩展性，并报告在“布局/可控生成”相关基准上优于既有 layout-based unified MLLM。引入 ATLAS-Reasoning 作为更偏“复杂空间+逻辑约束”的评测集，用来测 Think/Plan 的推理质量与生成可控性。
从全文叙述能确认的关键实验设计点：
- 对比对象：已有 layout-based unified MLLM（含 He et al. 路线）以及两种不同 Transfusion-style backbone 的实现对照。
- 关键消融方向（论文主张决定了消融应围绕这些点展开）：(a) 无 Think（直接 Plan）对复杂指令的布局完整性/一致性影响；(b) 无共享位置 token（或非共享空间表示）对理解/编辑/生成一致性的影响；(c) 无 RL layout alignment 对 plan-to-image fidelity 的影响；(d) 7B vs 80B 的 scaling 行为。
- 数字层面：给出的片段未包含完整表格与具体分数；但结论性描述是 80B 在生成表现上可与领先闭源大模型接近，并显著超过现有 layout-based unified MLLM。若要复现或复核，需要回到主结果表与 ATLAS-Reasoning 的分项指标（layout correctness、object count、spatial relation satisfaction、编辑一致性等）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看 Figure 2/3：把 Think/Plan/Paint 的数据流、layout 序列格式、共享位置 token 的作用搞清楚，这是全文的“接口定义”。
- 重点读 Shared Positional Tokens 的离散化细节（1000 桶、x/y 分词表、box 序列化方式），因为它决定了 tokenizer/表示层面的可迁移性与上限。
- 读 Think 阶段的 Layout-Aware CoT 例子：关注它如何把“数量、关系、约束”变成可监督的中间文本，以及它与 Plan 的条件依赖如何实现。
- 读 RL-based layout alignment：搞清楚 reward/对齐度量来自哪里、训练是在何阶段插入、是否只做后期对齐（类似 cooldown/annealing 的角色）。这部分对“RL 作为跨模态一致性校准”最有启发。
- 最后看 ATLAS-Reasoning 的构造与题型：它更像诊断集，能帮助判断模型到底是布局推理弱还是渲染对齐弱。

summary_en.core_problem: Unified multimodal LLMs still fail at controllable image generation under complex spatial instructions and logical constraints. The paper attributes this to two practical gaps: (1) layout is often predicted directly from the prompt without an explicit reasoning step to decompose entities, counts, and relations, leading to incomplete or inconsistent plans; (2) layout is treated as an auxiliary control signal rather than a shared spatial representation spanning planning, generation, editing, and understanding, which limits interpretability and editability.
summary_en.importance: The main value for foundation-model pretraining is not a marginal gain on image-generation benchmarks, but a concrete recipe for making “structure as tokens” work in unified AR multimodal models. By discretizing spatial positions into a shared token vocabulary and threading it through reasoning → layout planning → rendering, ATLAS turns controllability into something that can be supervised, diagnosed, and later calibrated. The RL-based layout alignment is also a useful pattern: RL is used as a late-stage consistency corrector between intermediate plans and final generations, analogous to a targeted alignment/cooldown stage rather than a full replacement of pretraining objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ATLAS implements a three-stage pipeline—Think, Plan, Paint—where layout is the cross-modal bridge.
- Shared Positional Tokens: continuous coordinates are quantized into 1000 bins; separate token sets for x and y (<pos_x_k>, <pos_y_k>) form a unified spatial vocabulary. Each object is serialized as (label, box) with four position tokens (x1,y1,x2,y2). The key design choice is that the same spatial tokens are reused across understanding, planning, generation, and editing.
- Think: a layout-aware chain-of-thought that explicitly derives entities, counts, and spatial constraints before committing to coordinates. This is meant to avoid prompt→layout shortcutting and to leverage text-side reasoning to structure the visual side.
- Plan: conditioned on the reasoning trace R, the model generates a layout sequence L = {(c_i, b_i)}.
- Paint: a Transfusion-style unified autoregressive backbone renders images from the planned layout. To improve plan-to-image fidelity, the paper adds RL-based layout alignment, optimizing generation to better match the planned boxes (mitigating missing/misaligned objects).
- Instantiation: implemented on two unified AR backbones (BAGEL and Hunyuan Image 3.0) at 7B and 80B to demonstrate scalability and architectural portability.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports results at 7B and 80B and claims consistent improvements over prior layout-based unified MLLMs on controllable generation benchmarks, with the 80B model approaching leading closed models in generation quality while outperforming existing layout-aware unified baselines. It also introduces ATLAS-Reasoning, a benchmark targeting reasoning-heavy spatial/logical instructions to separately stress Think/Plan quality.
From the provided full-text excerpt, the most important experimental axes are clear even if specific table numbers are not visible here: ablations for (i) removing Think (direct Plan), (ii) removing shared positional tokens / non-shared spatial interface, (iii) removing RL alignment, and (iv) scaling from 7B to 80B. For replication or careful assessment, the critical items are the main result tables and the ATLAS-Reasoning breakdowns (constraint satisfaction, object count correctness, spatial relation adherence, edit consistency).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
1) Start with the system figures (workflow + token/interface diagrams) to internalize the exact layout serialization and where it is injected.
2) Read the Shared Positional Tokens section carefully; this is the core “tokenizer/representation” contribution and determines transferability.
3) Inspect Think-stage examples: focus on how constraints are verbalized and how they condition Plan.
4) Study the RL-based layout alignment details (reward definition, training stage, and whether it behaves like a late alignment/cooldown step).
5) End with ATLAS-Reasoning construction and metrics to understand what failures it can diagnose (planning vs rendering alignment).

recommendation.zh: 只看 layout 接口和 RL 对齐实验；它不改预训练范式，但会影响统一生成模型是否保留显式规划层的判断。
recommendation.en: Skim the layout interface and RL-alignment ablations; it does not change pretraining, but informs whether unified generators need an explicit planning layer.

paper.title: DiFA: Inference-Time Forward-Process Alignment for Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: The prevailing inference framework for diffusion models formulates generation fundamentally as a problem of numerical integration. This perspective casts the model as an exact estimator, neglecting the inherent statistical uncertainty of the denoising process. In this work, we propose Forward-Process Aligned Diffusion prediction (\textbf{DiFA}), a training-free framework that reframes inference-time data prediction refinement as a sequential state estimation problem. Rather than reusing past out

summary.core_problem: 现有扩散模型推理框架将生成视为数值积分问题，忽略去噪过程的统计不确定性，导致生成质量受限。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出一种免训练的推理时预测精炼框架 DiFA，将扩散生成重新建模为序列状态估计问题。
summary.technical_approach: 受卡尔曼滤波启发，把反向轨迹上的迭代数据预测视为相关观测，按结构一致性与噪声水平兼容性聚合历史预测形成前向对齐的时序共识；引入偏差引导机制自适应保留残差细节以对抗过平滑。
summary.experiments: 在图像生成任务上验证 DiFA 可在不重新训练的情况下提升扩散模型生成质量，具体指标与 baseline 未在摘要中给出。

summary_en.core_problem: Current diffusion inference frameworks treat generation as numerical integration and ignore the statistical uncertainty of the denoising process, limiting sample quality.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution; proposes DiFA, a training-free inference-time prediction refinement framework that reframes diffusion generation as sequential state estimation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Inspired by Kalman filtering, treats iterative predictions along the reverse trajectory as correlated observations and aggregates them by structural consistency and noise-level compatibility to form a forward-aligned temporal consensus; introduces a deviation guidance mechanism to adaptively preserve residual details and counter over-smoothing.
summary_en.experiments: Empirically validated on image generation tasks, showing quality improvements without retraining; specific metrics and baselines are not detailed in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 扩散推理时优化的小创新，对做多模态生成的人有参考，对 LLM 预训练研究员价值有限，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: A minor diffusion inference-time optimization, relevant to multimodal generation researchers but of limited value to LLM pretraining researchers; abstract is sufficient.

paper.title: Compression Asymmetry and Trajectory Binding in Noise-Anchored Diffusion Inversion
paper.abstract: Real-image diffusion inversion is governed by a tight quality-cost trade-off, with costs incurred in computation, storage, or per-image optimization. We study this trade-off through the forward Gaussian noise anchor that defines a diffusion trajectory and isolate two mechanisms behind effective stored-noise inversion. First, diffusion noise exhibits an element-wise compression asymmetry: int8 full-dimensional anchors preserve reconstruction, whereas low-dimensional subspace summaries are much le

summary.core_problem: 研究真实图像 diffusion inversion 中重建质量、存储成本和计算成本之间的取舍，尤其是应保存哪类噪声锚点才能稳定反演。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是图像扩散模型反演机制分析和训练无关方法改进；它不直接服务 LLM 预训练，但对理解 diffusion 轨迹、噪声表示和生成模型可逆性有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文围绕 forward Gaussian noise anchor 分析两点：第一，全维逐元素 int8 噪声锚点比低维子空间摘要更能保留重建质量；第二，反演效果依赖匹配的前向噪声锚点和已训练 score network，不只是代数恒等式。基于这些观察提出 Noise-Anchored Reverse Correction，作为无需训练的 inversion 方法。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到在五种 stored-noise inversion 方法上观察到一致的元素级压缩优于子空间压缩现象，但未给出模型、数据集、分辨率、存储预算或重建指标的具体数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the quality-cost trade-off in real-image diffusion inversion, focusing on what kind of stored noise anchor preserves reconstruction quality.
summary_en.importance: It is a mechanism analysis and training-free method paper for image diffusion inversion. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it offers useful signal on diffusion trajectories, noise representations, and reversibility.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis centers on the forward Gaussian noise anchor. It argues that full-dimensional element-wise int8 anchors preserve reconstruction better than low-dimensional subspace summaries, and that inversion is tied to both the matched forward anchor and the trained score network. These observations motivate Noise-Anchored Reverse Correction, a training-free inversion method.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that the element-wise-over-subspace ordering holds across five stored-noise inversion methods, but does not provide concrete model names, datasets, resolutions, storage budgets, or reconstruction metrics.

recommendation.zh: 只看噪声锚点压缩那组实验即可；对 diffusion LM 没有直接外推，但“轨迹绑定”这个 prior 值得记住。
recommendation.en: Read only the noise-anchor compression experiments; it does not transfer directly to diffusion LMs, but the trajectory-binding prior is worth remembering.

paper.title: EMPURPLE: A Free Lunch for Diffusion Distillation based on the Information Bottleneck
paper.abstract: Diffusion models achieve impressive image-generation quality but remain expensive at inference time. Diffusion distillation reduces sampling steps, yet many distilled models, including SDXL-Lightning and distribution matching distillation methods, suffer from degraded Fréchet Inception Distance (FID). We analyze this phenomenon through a PAC-style generalization bound. Our analysis suggests that aggressive early-step redirection of the velocity field makes the distillation target harder to learn

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散模型蒸馏在大幅减少采样步数后，生成质量尤其是 FID 明显恶化的问题，并试图解释这种退化来自哪里。
summary.importance: 贡献有两层：一是给出一个关于蒸馏退化的机制解释，把问题归因到早期步 velocity field 被过度重定向后带来的训练-推理分布失配；二是提出一个无需重新训练的修补方法。对做新型语言建模范式的人，价值主要在于其对离散/连续 diffusion distillation 稳定性的分析思路，而不是图像结果本身。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先用 PAC-style generalization bound 分析蒸馏误差，指出 aggressive early-step redirection 会让目标更难学，扩大 train-test gap，并使中间 noisy latent 在训练与推理时分布不一致。基于这个判断，提出 EMPURPLE：训练时不改模型、推理时回收原始教师模型采样得到的中间 latent，以减轻后续步骤输入分布漂移。方法是 training-free、model-agnostic 的补丁式方案。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到方法适用于 SDXL-Lightning 和 distribution matching distillation 一类蒸馏模型，主要指标是 FID 改善，并通过中间特征与最终输出多样性下降来支撑其失配解释。未见与文本 diffusion LM 的直接实验，也没有 foundation-model 规模训练；因此更适合作为机制类旁证，而不是直接可迁移 recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why diffusion distillation often degrades generation quality, especially FID, when the number of sampling steps is aggressively reduced.
summary_en.importance: Its value is twofold: it offers a mechanism-level explanation for distillation failure—early-step velocity-field redirection creates a train-inference distribution mismatch—and proposes a training-free fix. For researchers exploring non-AR language modeling, the main takeaway is the analysis template for diffusion distillation stability rather than the image results themselves.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper derives a PAC-style generalization argument suggesting that aggressive early-step redirection makes the distilled target harder to learn, enlarges the train-test gap, and causes mismatch in intermediate noisy latents between training and inference. Based on this, it proposes EMPURPLE, a training-free and model-agnostic method that recycles intermediate latents sampled from the original teacher model to reduce downstream input shift.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions applicability to models such as SDXL-Lightning and distribution-matching distillation methods, with improvements measured mainly by FID. It also uses reduced diversity in intermediate features and final outputs as evidence for the mismatch hypothesis. There is no direct experiment on text diffusion LMs or foundation-scale pretraining, so this is better treated as a mechanism-side signal than a directly transferable recipe.

recommendation.zh: 和 LLM 不直接相关，但“蒸馏失败来自中间态分布失配”这个判断值得借到 diffusion LM；只看机制分析和 ablation，别被图像 FID 细节带跑。
recommendation.en: Not directly about LLMs, but the claim that distillation fails due to intermediate-state distribution mismatch is worth porting to diffusion LMs; read the mechanism analysis and ablations, not the image-specific FID details.

paper.title: DisciplineGen-1M: A Large-Scale Dataset for Multidisciplinary Visual Generation and Editing
paper.abstract: Recent image generation and editing models can produce visually appealing natural images, yet they remain unreliable when the target image is a knowledge-intensive diagram whose correctness depends on disciplinary concepts, symbolic structure, and precise spatial relations. We introduce DisciplineGen-1M, a million-scale multidisciplinary dataset that supports text-to-image generation and image editing. It contains 1.2M samples spanning mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, geography, compute

summary.core_problem: 现有图像生成/编辑模型在知识密集型“学科图表/示意图”上不可靠，缺少大规模、可控、带结构监督的数据来训练与评测。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是百万级合成+过滤的数据集与构建流水线；对多模态生成/编辑的预训练数据配方、可控编辑监督、以及“符号结构+空间关系”建模有参考价值，但仍偏图像生成数据资产。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DisciplineGen-1M：结合矢量图渲染、OCR 驱动编辑、程序化合成、以及大规模 text-to-image 过滤，产出 1.2M 跨学科样本；提供 caption、编辑指令、结构化标注与成对图像（语义差异可控）。并在其上训练“discipline-informed reasoning-generation model”用于 T2I 与编辑（摘要未给出细节）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出训练的生成/编辑模型规模、基线与量化提升；主要信息是数据规模（1.2M）与覆盖学科（数理化生地/CS/经济/历史/音乐/体育）。

summary_en.core_problem: Current image generation/editing models are unreliable on knowledge-intensive diagrams that require disciplinary concepts, symbolic structure, and precise spatial relations; large-scale controllable data is missing.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a million-scale synthetic+filtered dataset and pipeline; useful for multimodal generation/editing pretraining data recipes and controllable edit supervision, but still a data asset for image generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: DisciplineGen-1M is built via vector-graphics rendering, OCR-based editing, curated programmatic synthesis, and large-scale text-to-image filtering, producing captions, edit instructions, structured annotations, and paired images with controlled semantic differences. A discipline-informed reasoning-generation model is trained on top (details not in abstract).
summary_en.experiments: The abstract lacks model sizes, baselines, and quantitative gains; key reported facts are 1.2M samples and broad disciplinary coverage.

recommendation.zh: 把“可验证的图表/符号结构”做成 1M 级生成+编辑数据，这点比模型更值钱；先看数据构建与过滤流程，模型结果当弱信号。
recommendation.en: The 1M-scale diagram/symbolic-structure generation+editing data is the real value; read the pipeline/filtering, treat model claims as weak until numbers are checked.

paper.title: MEPA: Multi-Scale Representation Alignment for Visual Autoregressive Modeling with Mixture of Experts
paper.abstract: Visual AutoRegressive modeling (VAR) has pioneered a coarse-to-fine multi-scale autoregressive generative paradigm, demonstrating strong capabilities in image generation. However, VAR still suffers from inherent deficiencies in multi-scale representation learning. Specifically, lower scales primarily capture global semantics, while higher scales focus on fine-grained details. Employing a shared architecture across scales induces optimization conflicts. Moreover, due to the causal autoregressive

summary.core_problem: 解决 Visual AutoRegressive image generation 中多尺度表征学习冲突的问题：低尺度偏全局语义，高尺度偏细节，共享网络会让不同尺度的优化目标互相干扰。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是图像生成建模方法改进。它对 LLM 预训练研究员的价值主要在于：把 AR 生成、scale-conditioned routing、外部自监督特征对齐放在同一个视觉 token 生成框架里，可作为视觉 AR tokenizer/生成器设计的参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MEPA：一是 scale-aware token-routed MoE，让不同尺度的视觉 token 选择不同专家，降低共享参数在语义尺度和细节尺度之间的冲突；二是在早期粗尺度引入外部自监督视觉特征，增强语义建模；三是设计 residual feature aggregation，避免简单特征对齐带来的表征干扰。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称在图像生成任务上相对 VAR 类 baseline 改善生成质量，并缓解早期语义错误向高分辨率细节传播的问题；提供信息中没有给出模型规模、训练数据、FID/IS 等具体数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets representation conflicts in visual autoregressive generation, where coarse scales encode semantics and fine scales encode details, but a shared architecture is asked to serve both.
summary_en.importance: This is a method contribution for image generation. Its relevance to LLM pretraining is indirect: it gives a concrete design point for scale-conditioned routing and feature alignment in autoregressive visual token models.
summary_en.technical_approach: MEPA combines a scale-aware token-routed MoE with external self-supervised feature alignment at early scales. The MoE separates experts by generation scale, while a residual aggregation design is used to avoid overly rigid feature matching.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports improvements over VAR-style image generation baselines and claims better semantic consistency through the coarse-to-fine chain. The provided text does not include model size, datasets, or metric numbers.

recommendation.zh: 只看 MoE routing 和早期语义对齐设计即可；这是视觉 AR 的工程改良，不会改变语言建模 prior。
recommendation.en: Skim the MoE routing and early semantic-alignment design; this is a useful visual-AR engineering variant, not a language-modeling prior changer.

paper.title: PhotoQuilt: Training-Free Arbitrary-Resolution Photomosaics via Bootstrapped Tiled Denoising
