paper.abstract: Photomosaics are large images whose local regions are seen as independent tiles while their overall arrangement forms a coherent scene. Generating them at high resolution, with every tile convincing in its own right, is computationally expensive, since the canvas must hold many detailed tiles at once. We present PhotoQuilt, a training-free framework that generates photomosaics at arbitrary resolution. Diffusion models struggle to satisfy both scales at once, as direct high-resolution generation

summary.core_problem: 现有扩散模型难以同时满足高分辨率照片马赛克的局部tile细节真实性与全局布局一致性，直接生成计算成本高且易输出平滑图像，分块生成则丢失全局结构。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出训练自由的任意分辨率照片马赛克生成框架，无需修改扩散模型权重即可兼顾全局布局约束与局部tile生成质量。
summary.technical_approach: 提出自举式分块去噪流程：先生成低分辨率全局图像确定整体布局，再在潜空间上采样并重新注入噪声恢复生成能力，随后在固定尺寸的tile内分块去噪，通过共享全局潜变量保证各tile的结构一致性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露完整实验配置、模型参数量、对比基线及量化效果，仅说明方法无需额外训练即可支持任意分辨率照片马赛克生成，同时兼顾局部细节与全局结构。
summary.authors_note: 合作机构包括University of Toronto、Vector Institute、Samsung Research、KITE Research Institute、Queen’s University。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing diffusion models struggle to balance local tile detail fidelity and global layout consistency for high-resolution photomosaics; direct generation is computationally expensive and tends to produce smooth images, while patch-based tiling loses global structure.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a training-free framework for arbitrary-resolution photomosaic generation, which balances global layout constraints and local tile quality without modifying diffusion model weights.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a bootstrapped tiled denoising pipeline: first generates a low-resolution global image to fix the layout, then upsamples in latent space and re-injects noise to restore generative capacity, followed by tiled denoising within fixed-size tiles to preserve consistency via shared global latents.
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental setup, model parameters, baselines, and quantitative results are not disclosed in the provided abstract; only stated that the method supports arbitrary-resolution photomosaic generation without extra training, balancing local detail and global structure.
summary_en.authors_note: Collaborative team including University of Toronto, Vector Institute, Samsung Research, KITE Research Institute, and Queen’s University.

recommendation.zh: 扩散模型分块生成的全局布局锚定思路可参考，用于长序列扩散LM或高分辨率多模态生成，仅看方法流程即可。
recommendation.en: Global layout anchoring for tiled diffusion generation is worth referencing for long-sequence diffusion LM or high-res multimodal generation; only the pipeline section is needed.

paper.title: TMP: Tree-structured Mixed-policy Pruning for Large-scale Image Generation and Editing
paper.abstract: Modern image generation model rapidly grows their sizes to meet high-fidelity image synthesis. However, they gradually become unaffordable for their enormous parameter consumption and computation budget that lead to massive resources requirement and gpu memory footprint. In this paper, we propose TMP, the first Tree-structured Mixed-policy Pruning framework that generalizes prevalent image tasks (T2I and TI2I) and architectures (Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) and Diffusion transformer (DiT)). It could

summary.core_problem: 如何在尽量少损伤生成质量的前提下，把超大规模图像生成/编辑模型压到可负担的推理成本与显存占用。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在推理侧模型压缩：把“结构化剪枝 + 不同子模块混合策略”做成可覆盖 MoE 与 DiT、T2I 与 TI2I 的统一框架，并给出大模型（80B 级）可在单卡消费级 GPU 跑起来的工程落地案例。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Tree-structured Mixed-policy Pruning (TMP)：用树状结构组织剪枝决策，在不同层/模块上采用不同剪枝策略（mixed-policy），声称可同时适配 MoE 与 DiT 架构；定位为 step-distilled 模型的最后阶段压缩，并配合工程优化降低显存与推理开销。
summary.experiments: 在开源 HunyuanImage-3.0 instruct 与 Z-Image turbo 上实验；报告将 HunyuanImage 从 80B 剪到 20B（75% 参数下降）且“有限”质量损失；并声称通过工程技巧使 20B 版本可在单张 24GB RTX 4090 上推理。摘要未给出明确指标/对比细节。

summary_en.core_problem: How to compress very large image generation/editing models to affordable inference cost and memory footprint with limited quality degradation.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an inference-side compression contribution: a unified structured pruning framework claimed to cover both MoE and DiT, across T2I and image editing, plus a practical case of running an 80B-class model after pruning on a single consumer GPU.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Tree-structured Mixed-policy Pruning (TMP): organizes pruning decisions in a tree and applies different pruning policies across layers/modules, targeting both MoE and DiT. Positioned as a final-stage compression step for step-distilled models, coupled with engineering optimizations for memory/inference.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on open-source HunyuanImage-3.0 instruct and Z-Image turbo; reports compressing HunyuanImage from 80B to 20B (75% reduction) with limited quality loss, and enabling inference of the pruned 20B model on a single 24GB RTX 4090. The abstract does not provide concrete metrics/baselines.

recommendation.zh: 偏工程的生成模型剪枝落地，和基座预训练关系不大；想借鉴“MoE/DiT 统一剪枝接口”可扫一眼，但质量评估是否干净要打问号。
recommendation.en: Mostly an engineering-oriented pruning story, weakly tied to foundation pretraining; skim only if you care about a unified pruning interface for MoE/DiT, but treat quality claims as weak without clean eval.

paper.title: Don't Settle at the Mode! Mitigating Diversity Collapse in Pretrained Flow Models via Feature Self-Guidance
paper.abstract: State-of-the-art flow models generate stunning images from text or image prompts. However, they suffer from diversity collapse when generating multiple samples under the same conditioning. Existing methods address this issue via either latent guidance, which has limited effectiveness, or sample selection, which relies on external reward models that incur significant inference-time overhead. In this work, we introduce an efficient, training-free self-guidance mechanism to mitigate diversity colla

summary.core_problem: 如何缓解预训练流模型（Flow Models）在相同条件（如文本提示）下生成样本时的多样性崩溃（Diversity Collapse）问题，且不引入额外推理开销？
summary.importance: 提出了一种免训练、无需外部奖励模型的特征自引导（Feature Self-Guidance）机制，有效提升了流模型生成的多样性。
summary.technical_approach: 在批量生成过程中，通过特征自引导分散流模型的内部特征。同时引入流形正则化（manifold regularization）步骤，将分散的特征投影回数据流形，确保在提升多样性的同时不牺牲与输入条件的对齐度。作为即插即用模块集成到预训练模型中。
summary.experiments: 在图像生成任务中，相比依赖隐式引导或样本选择的方法，该方法在不增加显著推理开销的情况下提升了生成多样性。

summary_en.core_problem: How to mitigate diversity collapse in pretrained flow models when generating samples under the same conditioning, without introducing additional inference overhead?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a training-free feature self-guidance mechanism that requires no external reward models, effectively improving the generation diversity of flow models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Disperses the internal features of the flow model during batch generation via feature self-guidance. Introduces a manifold regularization step to project these dispersed features back onto the data manifold, ensuring diverse generation without sacrificing alignment with input conditions. Integrates as a plug-and-play module.
summary_en.experiments: Improves generation diversity in image generation tasks compared to latent guidance or sample selection methods, without significant inference overhead.

recommendation.zh: 针对 Flow Model 图像生成多样性崩溃的免训练干预方法，对理解连续生成模型的内部特征流形有一定参考价值，但偏图像生成应用。
recommendation.en: Training-free intervention for diversity collapse in Flow Model image generation. Offers some reference value for understanding internal feature manifolds of continuous generative models, but leans towards image generation applications.

paper.title: DanceOPD: On-Policy Generative Field Distillation
paper.abstract: Modern image generation demands a single model that unifies diverse capabilities, including text-to-image (T2I), local editing, and global editing. However, these capabilities are rarely naturally aligned and often conflict. For instance, editing tends to degrade T2I performance, while global and local editing interfere with each other. Consequently, effectively composing these capabilities has become a central challenge for image generation model training. To tackle this, we introduce DanceOPD,

summary.core_problem: 解决一个图像生成模型同时支持文生图、局部编辑和全局编辑时能力互相干扰的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多能力生成模型训练方法。它把不同能力看成共享 flow state space 上的多个 velocity field，并尝试用 on-policy distillation 组合这些能力。对 LLM 预训练的直接价值有限，但对“多目标、多能力、多专家信号如何合并到一个生成模型”有方法参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DanceOPD，即 on-policy generative field distillation。每个样本被路由到一个 capability field，学生模型在自己的 rollout state 上查询低噪声 student-induced state，然后用简单的 velocity MSE 学习对应专家场。该形式还能把 classifier-free guidance 这类 operator-defined field 纳入同一训练框架。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据、baseline、具体指标或提升幅度。可确认的实验目标应覆盖文生图、局部编辑和全局编辑的联合训练，但效果细节需要看正文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses capability interference when one image generation model is trained for text-to-image generation, local editing, and global editing.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training method for multi-capability generative models. It frames different capabilities as velocity fields in a shared flow state space and tries to compose them through on-policy distillation. Its direct value for LLM pretraining is limited, but the setup is relevant to combining heterogeneous objectives or expert signals into one generative model.
summary_en.technical_approach: DanceOPD routes each sample to one capability field, queries a low-noise student-induced state from the student's own rollout, and trains with a velocity MSE loss. The same formulation can absorb operator-defined fields such as classifier-free guidance.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model size, training data, baselines, metrics, or improvement numbers. The evaluated setting appears to cover joint text-to-image generation, local editing, and global editing, but the empirical strength needs to be checked in the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法定义即可；on-policy field distillation 对统一生成目标有参考，但没有语言建模证据，别过度外推。
recommendation.en: Read only the method formulation; on-policy field distillation is a useful analogy for unified generative objectives, but there is no LM evidence.

paper.title: Information-Theoretic Classifier-Free Guidance with Adaptive Schedule Optimization
paper.abstract: Diffusion models have achieved strong performance in image, text-to-image, and video generation, where conditional generation is often controlled by classifier-free guidance (CFG). CFG improves condition consistency by increasing a guidance weight, but stronger guidance typically reduces diversity and distributional coverage. It remains unclear how this consistency-coverage trade-off should be controlled across the reverse trajectory, since the distribution induced by CFG is not simply the fixed

summary.core_problem: 扩散模型的无分类器引导（CFG）通常采用全局固定引导权重，无法在整个反向生成轨迹上最优平衡条件一致性与样本多样性，且缺少逐时间步引导调度的principled优化框架
summary.importance: 提出信息论视角的CFG自适应调度优化框架，实现轨迹级别的一致性-多样性权衡最优控制，为扩散模型引导采样设计提供新的理论视角
summary.technical_approach: 以去噪端点的干净数据分布作为参考，显式定义期望的一致性-多样性权衡目标，将引导采样轨迹诱导的分布向参考分布优化；推导无需显式密度估计的轨迹级目标估计子，仅需样本和分数模型输出即可计算梯度，自适应优化每个时间步的引导权重
summary.experiments: 在ImageNet类别条件图像生成任务上验证，相比固定权重CFG基线，在相同FID下提升了条件分类准确率，或在相同一致性水平下提升了生成样本的多样性与分布覆盖率

summary_en.core_problem: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) in diffusion models typically uses a fixed global guidance weight, which cannot optimally balance conditional consistency and sample diversity across the full reverse trajectory, and lacks a principled framework for per-timestep guidance schedule optimization.
summary_en.importance: This work proposes an information-theoretic framework for adaptive CFG schedule optimization, achieving trajectory-level optimal tradeoff between consistency and diversity, and provides a new theoretical perspective for guided diffusion sampling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The clean endpoint data distribution is used as reference to define the desired consistency-diversity tradeoff, and the distribution induced by guided sampling is optimized toward this reference; trajectory-level objective estimators are derived that avoid explicit density estimation, using only samples and score outputs to compute gradients for adaptive per-timestep weight optimization.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on ImageNet class-conditional image generation, the method improves conditional classification accuracy at equal FID, or improves diversity and coverage at equal consistency, compared to fixed-weight CFG baselines.

recommendation.zh: 信息论框架下的扩散CFG自适应调度工作，仅在ImageNet图像生成上验证，做离散文本扩散的研究者扫一眼摘要即可，无需跟进细节
recommendation.en: Information-theoretic adaptive CFG schedule for diffusion, validated only on ImageNet; skip details unless you actively work on discrete diffusion LMs.

paper.title: Trajectory Forcing: Structure-First Generation with Controllable Semantic Trajectories
paper.abstract: Diffusion and flow-based generative models produce strong images, yet their controllability remains largely endpoint-centric: users specify conditions and receive final outputs, while the intermediate generative dynamics remain hidden. Recent methods have begun to exploit generation order and process decomposition to improve sample quality, but still treat intermediate states as internal computation rather than objects for interaction. We propose Trajectory Forcing (TF), a trajectory-centric fra

summary.core_problem: 解决扩散和 flow 图像生成主要由终点条件控制、生成中间过程不可见且不可编辑的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成范式与交互机制改造：把生成路径显式拆成可解码、可检查、可局部编辑的语义阶段，对结构优先生成有一定方法参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Trajectory Forcing，将合成过程组织为从全局布局到对象、部件、细节的语义轨迹。方法用 DINOv2 等预训练视觉表征聚类构造 coarse-to-fine teacher hierarchy，并训练模型逐阶段生成可解码 latent state，而不是只在最终图像上施加条件。
summary.experiments: 给定摘要未完整披露模型规模、训练数据、baseline 和定量结果。可确认的实验设定包括使用预训练视觉表征构造层级教师信号，并面向图像生成的可控性与过程编辑进行验证。
summary.authors_note: Bernhard Schölkopf 是因果学习与表示学习领域知名研究者，Andreas Geiger 是 3D 视觉和自动驾驶感知领域知名研究者；具体单位信息未在给定摘要中列出。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of inspectable and editable intermediate states in diffusion and flow-based image generation, where control is mostly specified only at the endpoint.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a generation-interface and modeling change: it turns the synthesis path into a sequence of semantic, decodable stages, which is relevant as a weak signal for structure-first generative modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trajectory Forcing organizes generation from global layout to objects, parts, and details. It derives coarse-to-fine teacher hierarchies by clustering pretrained visual representations such as DINOv2, then trains the model to produce decodable latent states at each stage instead of treating intermediate states as hidden computation.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not give model size, training data, baselines, or quantitative gains. It does specify experiments around pretrained visual-feature hierarchies and controllable image synthesis with editable intermediate latent states.
summary_en.authors_note: Bernhard Schölkopf is known for work in causality and representation learning, and Andreas Geiger is known for 3D vision and autonomous driving perception; institutional affiliations are not provided in the supplied abstract.

recommendation.zh: 不必细读；看方法图和层级 teacher 构造即可，可能给 diffusion LM 的中间态可控性一点旁证。
recommendation.en: No need to read closely; inspect the method figure and hierarchy construction as a weak analogy for controllable intermediate states in diffusion LMs.

paper.title: FreeStyle: Free Control of Style-Content Dual-Reference Generation from Community LoRA Mining
paper.abstract: Style-content dual-reference generation aims to synthesize an image that preserves the structure and semantics of a content reference while adopting the style of a separate style reference.Despite recent progress, this setting remains challenging because models must balance content fidelity, style alignment, and instruction following avoiding semantic leakage from the style reference.A key bottleneck is the lack of large-scale triplet data with clean content-style separation and broad long-tail

summary.core_problem: 解决双参考图像生成中内容参考、风格参考难以解耦的问题，即既保持内容结构和语义，又采用另一张图的风格，同时避免风格参考带入语义泄漏。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态生成的数据与训练框架，重点在大规模 style-content triplet 构造和解耦训练；对 LLM 预训练的直接相关性有限，但 community LoRA mining 作为弱结构化数据来源有可借鉴之处。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FreeStyle，将社区 LoRA 视为风格和内容的组合锚点，围绕多个 base model 设计生成和过滤管线，构造 Style-Reference 与 Content-Reference 三元组。训练上采用两阶段 curriculum，并使用阶段特定的 disentanglement 机制；摘要提到包含 attention-level enrichment 约束，以缓解内容泄漏和风格语义混入。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体训练集规模、模型参数量、基线和数值提升。可确认的是，数据覆盖多个 base model，并面向风格-内容双参考生成进行训练与评估。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles dual-reference image generation: preserving the structure and semantics of a content reference while adopting the style of a separate style reference without semantic leakage.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a multimodal generation data-and-training framework, centered on large-scale style-content triplet construction and disentangled training. It is only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining, but community LoRA mining is an interesting weakly structured data source.
summary_en.technical_approach: FreeStyle treats community LoRAs as compositional anchors for style and content, then builds a generation and filtering pipeline to create Style-Reference and Content-Reference triplets across multiple base models. Training uses a two-stage curriculum with stage-specific disentanglement mechanisms, including attention-level constraints mentioned in the abstract.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not report dataset size, model scale, baseline names, or numerical gains. It does state that the pipeline spans multiple base models and targets style-content dual-reference generation.

recommendation.zh: 可略看数据管线：community LoRA 当标签和锚点的思路能借鉴到合成偏好数据，但图像风格任务偏窄。
recommendation.en: Skim the data pipeline: using community LoRAs as labels and anchors may transfer to synthetic preference data, though the task is narrow.

paper.title: Learning When to Denoise: Optimizing Asynchronous Schedules for Latent Diffusion
paper.abstract: Multi-representation diffusion models can improve visual synthesis by denoising complementary views of an image, but their performance depends critically on the asynchronous schedule that determines when each representation is denoised. We propose to learn this schedule. Our method formulates asynchronous flow matching over multiple representation spaces and uses a schedule-corrected objective that keeps each representation's local noising-time weights fixed as the schedule changes. We instantia

summary.core_problem: 多表示 latent diffusion 中，不同表示空间何时去噪会显著影响生成质量，论文试图自动学习这个异步去噪时间表。
summary.importance: 贡献是扩散/flow matching 训练 recipe 的改进，重点在多表示生成模型的 schedule 优化。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但对离散/连续 diffusion LM 或统一多模态生成中的时间调度有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把多表示空间上的异步去噪写成 asynchronous flow matching，并提出 schedule-corrected objective：当 schedule 改变时，保持每个表示的局部 noising-time 权重不变，避免把 schedule 学习和训练权重变化混在一起。schedule 使用凸且单调的参数化形式，并通过一个小成本 joint probe 学习，额外训练计算小于 1%。
summary.experiments: 在 ImageNet 256x256 上使用匹配的 675M 参数 XL backbone。学习到的 schedule 提升收敛速度和最终质量；配合 AutoGuidance，200 epoch 模型达到 FID 1.05，接近 800 epoch SFD-XL baseline；训练到 600 epoch 时 FID 进一步到 1.02。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when each representation should be denoised in multi-representation latent diffusion, where the asynchronous schedule strongly affects generation quality.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-recipe improvement for diffusion and flow-matching generative models. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but the schedule-learning idea may be relevant to diffusion LMs or unified multimodal generators with multiple latent spaces.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method formulates asynchronous flow matching across multiple representation spaces and introduces a schedule-corrected objective that keeps each representation's local noising-time weights fixed as the schedule changes. The schedule is parameterized to be convex and monotone by construction and is learned with a fast joint probe costing less than 1% extra training compute.
summary_en.experiments: On ImageNet 256x256 with a matched 675M-parameter XL backbone, the learned schedule improves convergence and final quality. With AutoGuidance, a 200-epoch model reaches FID 1.05, matching the 800-epoch SFD-XL baseline; extending training to 600 epochs gives FID 1.02.

recommendation.zh: 只看 objective 校正和 schedule 参数化；对 diffusion LM 有类比价值，但图像 FID 结果不能直接外推到文本。
recommendation.en: Read only the objective correction and schedule parameterization; the analogy to diffusion LMs is useful, but ImageNet FID should not be over-interpreted for text.

paper.title: SpectralDiT: Timestep-Conditioned Spectral Residual Correction for Flow-Matching DiTs
paper.abstract: We propose SpectralDiT, a lightweight modification to flow-matching Diffusion Transformers that adds timestep-conditioned spectral correction to the MLP residual branch. The module decomposes each residual update into low- and high-frequency components on the patch-token grid, then learns a zero-initialized additive gate so the model initially matches the baseline DiT. On CIFAR-10 pixel-space generation, SpectralDiT improves FID from 20.78 to 19.71 at patch size 1 and reduces the radial Fourier

summary.core_problem: 改进 flow-matching Diffusion Transformer 在图像生成中的频谱建模，使残差更新更好覆盖低频和高频成分。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是图像生成架构的小幅改进。它对 LLM 预训练不是直接相关，但 DiT/flow matching 是多模态生成基座的常用组件，频谱残差分析对视觉 tokenizer 或统一生成模型的视觉分支有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SpectralDiT，在 DiT 的 MLP residual branch 中加入 timestep-conditioned spectral correction。模块在 patch-token 网格上把残差更新分解为低频和高频分量，并使用 zero-initialized additive gate，使训练初始行为与 baseline DiT 一致，再逐步学习频谱校正。
summary.experiments: 在 CIFAR-10 pixel-space generation 上，FID 从 20.78 降到 19.71，并缩小 radial Fourier spectrum gap；在 ImageNet-100 latent diffusion 上，增加 0.6% 理论 FLOPs 和 1.36% 参数量，在 CFG 2.0 下获得 8.7% 相对 FID 降幅。结果报告为五个随机种子的平均值，并提供 CIFAR-10 上的消融和 gate 可视化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper improves frequency modeling in flow-matching Diffusion Transformers for image generation by adding spectral residual correction.
summary_en.importance: This is a small architecture modification for image generation. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but DiT and flow matching are common components in multimodal generative foundation models, and the spectral-residual analysis may be useful for visual branches or unified generation systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: SpectralDiT adds a timestep-conditioned spectral correction module to the MLP residual branch of a DiT. The module decomposes residual updates into low- and high-frequency components on the patch-token grid, and uses a zero-initialized additive gate so the model initially behaves like the baseline before learning spectral corrections.
summary_en.experiments: On CIFAR-10 pixel-space generation, FID improves from 20.78 to 19.71 and the radial Fourier spectrum gap is reduced. On ImageNet-100 latent diffusion, the method adds 0.6% theoretical FLOPs and 1.36% parameters, and reports an 8.7% relative FID reduction under CFG 2.0. Results are averaged over five seeds, with ablations and gate visualizations on CIFAR-10.

recommendation.zh: 看实验表和 gate 可视化即可；这是干净的 DiT 小补丁，可能有用，但还不足以改变对 flow matching 架构的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the result table and gate visualizations only; it is a clean DiT patch that may be useful, but it does not yet change the prior on flow-matching architectures.

paper.title: Shift-and-Sum Quantization for Visual Autoregressive Models
paper.abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) enables efficient deployment of deep networks using a small set of data. Its application to visual autoregressive models (VAR), however, remains relatively unexplored. We identify two key challenges for applying PTQ to VAR: (i) large reconstruction errors in attention-value products, especially at coarse scales where high attention scores occur more frequently; and (ii) a discrepancy between the sampling frequencies of codebook entries and their predicted probabi

summary.core_problem: 为视觉自回归生成模型设计后训练量化方法，降低部署成本，同时控制注意力和 codebook 预测中的误差放大。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向 VAR 的 PTQ 方法。它主要服务图像生成部署，但对统一 AR 多模态模型的量化误差来源有一定参考价值，尤其是离散视觉 token 与注意力 value 量化的交互。
summary.technical_approach: 先指出 VAR 量化的两个问题：粗尺度高注意力分数下 attention-value product 重构误差大；少量 calibration data 导致 codebook 条目采样频率与预测概率不匹配。对应提出 shift-and-sum quantization，通过对 value token 做对称 shifted duplicates 并聚合量化结果来降低重构误差；再用 calibration resampling 让 codebook 采样频率更接近模型预测分布。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 class-conditional image generation 和 inpainting 等视觉生成任务。摘要未给出具体 VAR 模型规模、量化 bit-width、校准集大小和数值提升；重点应看量化后生成质量与重构误差的消融。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper develops post-training quantization for visual autoregressive models, aiming to reduce deployment cost while controlling error amplification in attention and codebook prediction.
summary_en.importance: This is a PTQ method for VAR image generators. It mainly targets visual-generation deployment, but it is somewhat relevant to unified AR multimodal models because it analyzes quantization errors around discrete visual tokens and attention-value products.
summary_en.technical_approach: It identifies two VAR-specific PTQ issues: large reconstruction errors in attention-value products, especially at coarse scales with high attention scores, and a mismatch between sampled codebook-entry frequencies and predicted probabilities under limited calibration data. It proposes shift-and-sum quantization, aggregating quantized outputs from symmetrically shifted value-token duplicates, plus calibration resampling to align codebook sampling with prediction probabilities.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover class-conditional image generation and inpainting. The abstract does not report VAR model sizes, bit widths, calibration-set size, or exact numerical gains; the key evidence should be post-quantization generation quality and reconstruction-error ablations.

recommendation.zh: 只对做统一 AR 图像 token 模型的人有用；看误差分析即可，方法是否迁移到文本 LM 量化存疑。
recommendation.en: Useful mainly for people building unified AR image-token models; read the error analysis, while transfer to text-LM quantization is doubtful.

paper.title: Flow-DPPO: Divergence Proximal Policy Optimization for Flow Matching Models
paper.abstract: Recent work has demonstrated that online reinforcement learning (RL) can substantially improve the quality and alignment of flow matching models for image and video generation. Methods such as Flow-GRPO and CPS cast the denoising process as a Markov Decision Process and apply PPO-style ratio clipping to enforce a trust region. However, we argue that ratio clipping is structurally ill-suited for flow models: the probability ratio between new and old policies is a noisy, single-sample estimate of

summary.core_problem: 改进 flow matching 图像和视频生成模型的在线 RL 优化，避免 PPO ratio clipping 在连续去噪轨迹中产生不稳定或错误的 trust region 约束。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型后训练方法改进。它不直接推进文本 LLM 预训练，但对“把生成过程视为 MDP 并用 RL 调生成模型”的接口有参考价值，尤其是 trust region 约束如何利用模型分布结构来做得更干净。
summary.technical_approach: Flow-DPPO 将 Flow-GRPO、CPS 一类方法中的 PPO ratio clipping 替换为 divergence proximal constraint。核心观察是 flow model 每一步 policy 可写成 Gaussian，因此新旧 policy 的 KL divergence 可以精确且低成本计算。方法进一步使用 asymmetric divergence mask：在超出约束的方向阻断梯度，在允许区域内保留优化信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体图像/视频模型规模、数据集、奖励模型、baseline 数量或提升幅度。可确认的 baseline 包括 Flow-GRPO 和 CPS，目标是提升 flow matching 生成模型的质量与对齐。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper improves online RL for flow-matching image and video generators by replacing noisy PPO ratio clipping with a better-specified trust-region constraint.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training method for generative flow models. It is not directly about text LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to the broader interface between generative modeling and RL-based alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Flow-DPPO replaces PPO-style ratio clipping used by methods such as Flow-GRPO and CPS with a divergence proximal constraint. The key observation is that each per-step policy in a flow model is Gaussian, so the KL divergence between old and new policies can be computed exactly and cheaply. An asymmetric divergence mask blocks gradients only when the update violates the desired trust region.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, reward models, or quantitative gains. It positions Flow-GRPO and CPS as the main baselines and targets quality/alignment improvements for image and video flow-matching models.

recommendation.zh: 只看 KL 约束替代 ratio clipping 的推导；对文本预训练不直接有用，但可借鉴到生成模型 RL 接口。
recommendation.en: Read only the KL-vs-ratio-clipping argument; it is not directly useful for text pretraining, but the RL interface design is transferable.

paper.title: Where Rectified Flows Leak: Characterising Membership Signals Along the Interpolation Path
paper.abstract: Understanding what generative models retain from training data remains challenging, with implications for copyright and privacy. Beyond verbatim reproduction, models can encode subtler traces of their training data that never surface in their outputs yet remain exploitable. We study this regime for Rectified Flows, which are increasingly used in deployed generative systems. We analyse the interpolation path $X_λ= (1-λ)X_0 + λX_1$ that defines the Rectified Flow training. We show that a gap exist

summary.core_problem: 研究 Rectified Flow 生成模型在训练数据成员推断上的泄漏信号，尤其是这些信号如何沿训练所定义的插值路径随 λ 变化。
summary.importance: 这是一篇生成模型隐私与记忆分析工作，贡献不在 LLM 预训练方法本身，而在于指出：即使验证指标稳定，模型内部仍可能积累可利用的训练集成员信号。对做统一生成建模、扩散/flow 训练目标设计的人有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者分析 Rectified Flow 的训练插值路径 X_λ=(1-λ)X_0+λX_1，比较 train/test 样本在不同 λ 处的重建差异，发现成员信号呈钟形曲线，并在高斯假设下推导峰值位置的闭式解。随后在音频和图像上验证 bell-shaped 结构的普遍性，并展示可基于特定 λ 分辨率构造成员推断攻击。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖音频与图像两个模态，核心比较是 train vs test reconstruction gap 随 λ 的变化，以及该信号如何随训练累积而验证指标却保持稳定。摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据量和攻击指标数值，因此更适合作为现象性结果而非可直接迁移的 recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies membership leakage in Rectified Flow generative models, focusing on how the signal evolves along the interpolation path parameterized by λ.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a privacy/memorization analysis paper for generative models rather than an LLM pretraining paper. Its value is in showing that exploitable membership signals can accumulate even when standard validation metrics remain stable, which is indirectly relevant to people working on diffusion/flow-style unified generative training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors analyze the Rectified Flow interpolation path X_λ=(1-λ)X_0+λX_1, measure train/test reconstruction gaps across λ, and find a bell-shaped membership signal. Under Gaussian assumptions, they derive a closed-form prediction for the peak location. They then validate the phenomenon on both audio and image models and demonstrate a proof-of-concept membership inference attack exploiting λ-specific resolution.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments span audio and image settings, with the main result being the train-vs-test reconstruction gap as a function of λ and its accumulation during training despite stable validation metrics. The abstract does not provide model sizes, dataset scales, or exact attack numbers, so this reads more as a phenomenon paper than a directly reusable recipe.

recommendation.zh: 和 LLM 基座关系不强，但如果你在看 diffusion/flow 式统一建模，值得记住它提醒了一件事：validation 很干净不代表训练目标没有在中间态泄漏成员信息，正文只需看现象图和闭式峰值推导。
recommendation.en: Not central to LLM pretraining, but if you care about diffusion/flow-style generative training, keep the warning: clean validation does not mean the objective is not leaking membership in intermediate states; the phenomenon plots and peak derivation are the only parts worth reading.

paper.title: Spectral Guidance for Flexible and Efficient Control of Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: We introduce Spectral Guidance, a framework for controlling diffusion models by leveraging the intrinsic geometry of the generative process. As data is progressively corrupted by noise, only a small number of features remain informative for control. We characterize them as the singular functions of a conditional expectation operator and show that they can be learned via a self-supervised objective. Once recovered, this basis enables the projection of arbitrary guidance signals, such as labels, C

summary.core_problem: 解决 diffusion model 在不重训、不对 denoiser 做反向传播的条件下，如何稳定、灵活地接受 label、CLIP embedding、mask 等控制信号的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型控制方法。它从 diffusion 采样过程的内在几何出发，提出一种训练后可复用的 guidance 表示，目标是在控制精度、采样速度和图像质量之间取得更好的折中。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Spectral Guidance。核心假设是数据逐步加噪后，只有少量特征仍对控制有信息量；这些特征可表示为 conditional expectation operator 的 singular functions。作者用 self-supervised objective 学习这组 basis，再把任意 guidance signal 投影到采样轨迹上，从而支持 label、CLIP 和 mask-based spatial control。
summary.experiments: 在 CIFAR-10 上，相比最强 training-free baseline，conditional accuracy 提升 37 个百分点，并报告约 4 倍采样加速。摘要还称同一组表示可支持 label guidance、CLIP guidance 和 mask guidance，无需额外辅助模型或 sampling-time denoiser backpropagation。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to control diffusion models with labels, CLIP embeddings, or masks without retraining the denoiser or backpropagating through it at sampling time.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a generative-model control method. It uses the intrinsic geometry of the diffusion process to derive reusable guidance representations, aiming for a better trade-off between controllability, fidelity, and sampling cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: Spectral Guidance assumes that as data is corrupted by noise, only a small number of features remain informative for control. These features are characterized as singular functions of a conditional expectation operator and learned with a self-supervised objective. Arbitrary guidance signals are then projected onto the sampling trajectory.
summary_en.experiments: On CIFAR-10, the method improves conditional accuracy by 37 percentage points over the strongest training-free baseline and reports 4× faster sampling. The same learned representations are claimed to support label guidance, CLIP guidance, and mask-based spatial control without auxiliary models.

recommendation.zh: 和 LLM 预训练距离较远；若关心 unified diffusion control，看 operator/basis 形式即可。
recommendation.en: Far from LLM pretraining; if you care about unified diffusion control, skim the operator-and-basis formulation only.

paper.title: GenClaw: Code-Driven Agentic Image Generation
paper.abstract: Image generation models have evolved from text-conditioned pixel synthesis toward multimodal agents endowed with visual comprehension and tool invocation capabilities. Yet, existing agents remain at the mercy of underlying black-box image models. Their workflow is trapped in a repetitive cycle of prompt rewriting for generation refinement, leaving them with no mechanism to directly manipulate the canvas. In essence, the potential of LLMs to serve as a genuine "brush" for precise visual construct

summary.core_problem: 解决图像生成 agent 只能反复改 prompt、无法直接控制画布结构的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态生成工作流创新：把 LLM 的代码生成能力作为可执行视觉草图中间层，再交给图像生成模型补纹理和材质。它对 agentic generation 有参考价值，但离 LLM 基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GenClaw。流程分三步：先通过搜索和推理构建概念知识与上下文；再生成 SVG、HTML、Three.js 等代码来渲染可执行视觉草图；最后调用图像生成模型补充纹理、材质和细节。核心思想是用代码作为可控结构表示，而不是只做自然语言 prompt rewrite。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供模型规模、数据、基线或定量结果。实验应主要围绕图像构图可控性、视觉质量和与 prompt-only agent 的比较。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the limitation that image-generation agents mostly refine prompts and cannot directly manipulate the canvas structure.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a workflow innovation for multimodal generation: using the LLM’s coding ability as an executable visual-sketch intermediate before invoking an image generator for textures and materials. It is relevant to agentic generation but not central to LLM foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: GenClaw uses a three-stage process. The agent first builds conceptual knowledge and context through search and reasoning, then writes code such as SVG, HTML, or Three.js to render executable sketches, and finally uses an image generation model to add texture, material, and detail. The key idea is code as a controllable structural representation rather than natural-language prompt rewriting.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, data, baselines, or quantitative results. The evaluation likely focuses on compositional controllability, image quality, and comparisons with prompt-only agents.

recommendation.zh: 作为 code-as-layout 的生成工作流备查即可；对预训练没有新信号，主要是 agent 工程形态。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a code-as-layout generation workflow reference; it adds little to pretraining and is mostly agent-engineering.

paper.title: VPG: Visual Prefix Guidance for Autoregressive Image and Video Generation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive image and video generators are trained with teacher-forced histories but must sample from their own generated prefixes at inference time, making them vulnerable to exposure bias and prefix drift. Existing remedies either modify training or apply sampling-time guidance aimed primarily at external semantic conditions, such as class labels or text prompts, rather than testing whether a next-step prediction provides strong posterior support for the generated prefix itself. We propose

summary.core_problem: 缓解自回归图像和视频生成中 teacher forcing 训练与自由采样推理之间的不匹配，尤其是生成前缀漂移问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练无关的推理时 guidance。它不改变模型训练，但提出用前缀自一致性信号修正下一步预测；对研究 AR 生成的 exposure bias 有类比价值，但离 LLM 基座预训练主线较远。
summary.technical_approach: Visual Prefix Guidance 对比同一模型在当前生成前缀和被污染前缀下的输出分布，并把 logits 外推到更支持当前前缀的候选 token。它不依赖额外训练，也不同于主要围绕类别或文本条件做 guidance 的方法，而是把生成历史本身作为要被后验支持的对象。
summary.experiments: 摘要称方法在 VAR 的类别条件图像生成、Infinity 的文生图和文生视频设置中测试，并提升自回归视觉生成效果；未给出具体指标、提升幅度和采样成本。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the mismatch between teacher-forced training and free-running inference in autoregressive image and video generation, especially prefix drift.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free inference-time guidance method. It does not modify pretraining, but it introduces a prefix self-support signal for next-step prediction, which is useful by analogy for studying exposure bias in AR generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Visual Prefix Guidance contrasts the model's output under the generated prefix with its output under a corrupted prefix, then extrapolates logits toward candidates that better support the current prefix. Unlike guidance aimed at class labels or text prompts, it treats the generated history itself as the object whose posterior support should be reinforced.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments on class-conditional image generation with VAR, text-to-image generation with Infinity, and text-to-video generation with Infinity-style models. It does not provide exact metrics, gains, or sampling overhead.

recommendation.zh: 看 abstract 和 guidance 公式就够；它是视觉 AR 解码技巧，不是会改变预训练 recipe 的证据。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and guidance equation only; this is a visual AR decoding trick, not evidence to change a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: Colored Noise Diffusion Sampling
paper.abstract: Diffusion models achieve state-of-the-art image synthesis, with their generative trajectories fundamentally exhibiting a spectral bias, resolving low-frequency global structures early and high-frequency fine details later. Conventional stochastic differential equation (SDE) solvers fail to account for this dynamic, naively injecting uniform white noise throughout the entire process and misusing the finite energy budget. In this work, we establish a mathematical framework that reconsiders SDE inf

summary.core_problem: 改进扩散模型采样时的噪声注入方式，避免传统 SDE solver 在所有频率上均匀注入白噪声而浪费有限采样能量。
summary.importance: 贡献是图像扩散模型的 training-free 采样器和生成动态分析；不直接服务 LLM 预训练，但对理解 diffusion 轨迹的频谱偏置、以及离散/连续 diffusion LM 的采样设计有弱相关参考。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把 SDE 推理重新表述为频率解耦的能量转移过程，提出 Colored Noise Sampling：根据 timestep 和频率动态调整噪声注入，把能量更多分配给尚未解析的频段，而不是使用全程均匀白噪声。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 CNS 是训练无关的 stochastic solver，并利用模型固有频谱偏置改善生成分布；未给出使用的具体图像扩散模型、数据集、baseline、采样步数或定量提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper revisits noise injection during diffusion sampling, arguing that standard SDE solvers waste the finite stochastic energy budget by injecting uniform white noise across all frequencies.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free sampler and an analysis of spectral dynamics in image diffusion models. It is not LLM pretraining work, but it is mildly relevant to sampling design in continuous or discrete diffusion language models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method frames SDE inference as frequency-decoupled energy transfer and introduces Colored Noise Sampling, which uses timestep- and frequency-dependent noise schedules to allocate stochastic energy toward unresolved frequency bands.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract presents CNS as a training-free stochastic solver exploiting spectral bias, but does not specify the exact image models, datasets, baselines, sampling budgets, or numerical improvements.

recommendation.zh: 结论有趣但离文本建模较远；只看频谱能量分配推导，别把图像采样经验直接搬到 DLM。
recommendation.en: Interesting but far from text modeling; read only the spectral energy-allocation argument and avoid directly importing image-sampling heuristics into DLMs.

paper.title: AdvantageFlow: Advantage-Weighted Least Squares for RL in Flow Models
paper.abstract: We introduce AdvantageFlow, a forward-process reinforcement learning algorithm for rectified flow models. Unlike Flow-GRPO, which optimizes the reverse process, we optimize an advantage-weighted forward-process prediction loss. This optimization problem is unstable when advantages are negative and the loss becomes non-convex. We stabilize it by rollout policy regularization, which reduces variance and arises from fitting a local reward-improving target distribution. We evaluate AdvantageFlow on

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 flow / rectified flow 图像生成模型在后训练阶段如何做更稳、更直接的 RL。已有主流做法如 Flow-GRPO，把反向去噪轨迹当作序列决策过程来做 policy gradient，但这一路线有两个结构性问题：一是原始采样是确定性 ODE，必须人为加噪改成 SDE 才能写出策略梯度；二是奖励只在最终图像上给出，中间去噪步骤的 credit assignment 很难。AdvantageFlow 试图绕开这两个问题：不在 reverse trajectory 上做 RL，而是在 forward training objective 上直接做 reward-weighted regression。更具体地说，它把 flow matching 里的 clean-image prediction loss 改写成 advantage-weighted least squares，用同 prompt 下 batch 内样本的相对优劣来重加权训练信号，同时引入 rollout policy regularization，解决负 advantage 导致的非凸与不稳定问题。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身的直接影响不大，因为它主要是图像生成模型的 post-training / preference optimization，而不是语言模型预训练 recipe。但它有两点值得关注。第一，它代表了一类“生成模型 RL 不一定要走 token-level / step-level policy gradient”的思路：如果预训练目标本身是回归式、去噪式或 flow matching 式，后训练也许可以尽量留在原训练目标附近，只改权重而不是改整个优化范式。第二，它把 reward optimization 写成局部 target distribution 拟合，并把 regularization 解释为方差缩减与凸性修复，这种推导方式对 diffusion LM、masked generative model、甚至部分非 AR 语言建模的 post-train 设计有启发。就量级看，这更像是一个方法论上的 clean-up 和统一解释，而不是会立刻改写 LLM 预训练主线的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是把 rectified flow 的 prediction loss从普通最小二乘，改成 advantage 加权的最小二乘。基础对象是 clean image predictor f_theta(x_t, t, c)，其中 x_t 是 clean image 与 Gaussian noise 的线性插值。标准训练时最小化 E||f_theta(x_t,t,c)-x_0||^2；AdvantageFlow 则对每个生成样本附上 advantage 权重，鼓励模型更贴近高奖励样本、远离低奖励样本。

难点在于 advantage 可以为负。若直接做负权最小二乘，单样本损失会变成非凸，优化容易发散。论文的处理不是简单截断负样本，而是引入 rollout regularization：用模型的 moving-average / rollout policy 构造一个 reward-independent 参考项，把原本高方差、带符号的目标分解成一个稳定的基准拟合项，加上 advantage 驱动的偏移项。文中把它解释为拟合一个局部线性倾斜的 target distribution：相当于在当前策略附近，按 exp 或一阶 tilt 的方式把概率质量向高奖励样本移动。regularization 对应于把 noisy sampled targets 替换成条件均值，从而降低方差，并保证每个样本上的目标函数严格凸。

从算法关系上看，作者还说明 negative-aware fine-tuning 这一类 forward-process RL baseline 可以被视为其方法在特定自适应 regularization 选择下的特例。这一点有价值，因为它把看似经验性的“负样本感知”技巧，纳入了统一的 advantage-weighted least-squares 框架。

和 reverse-process RL 相比，AdvantageFlow 的差异很明确：它不需要给采样过程额外注入随机性，不需要对每个去噪 step 做 credit assignment，也不需要显式 policy gradient estimator；训练对象仍然是 pretrain 时同一类 forward loss，只是样本权重发生变化。这使它在实现上更接近 supervised fine-tuning，而不是传统 RL。
summary.experiments:
实验基座是 Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium，任务是文本到图像生成的 reward optimization。论文比较了三类方法：AdvantageFlow、reverse-process 的 Flow-GRPO，以及 forward-process 的 negative-aware fine-tuning baseline。摘要和正文给出的结论是一致的：AdvantageFlow 在多个 reward model 下都优于两类基线，并且还能扩展到 multi-objective optimization。

从实验设计看，作者重点验证了四件事。第一，forward-process RL 是否真的能在不做 reverse credit assignment 的情况下提升 reward；答案是可以。第二，rollout regularization 是否只是工程稳定器，还是方法必要组成；消融显示它对稳定训练和最终效果都关键，尤其是在存在负 advantage 时。第三，方法是否会明显 reward hack；作者补充用了 GenEval 做外部评测，说明提升不只是 reward model 内部过拟合。第四，统一视角是否成立；通过把现有 forward baseline 写成特例，实验上也能解释不同 regularization 选择带来的性能差异。

当前公开内容里没有看到特别系统的 scaling 结果，也没有像 LLM 论文那样给出参数量、token budget、训练 FLOPs 与 loss 曲线的完整分析。它更像一篇算法论文：重点是目标函数、稳定性和 reward 指标，而不是大规模训练规律。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Algorithm 部分，抓住一个主线：为什么 reverse-process RL 在 flow model 上别扭，以及为什么 forward-process weighted regression 更自然。然后重点看作者如何从 local reward-improving target distribution 推出 advantage-weighted least squares，再看 rollout regularization 的两层作用：一层是 variance reduction，另一层是把负 advantage 带来的非凸问题修正为严格凸。

如果时间有限，建议优先看：1）方法推导里关于“negative advantages make the loss non-convex”的段落；2）把现有 negative-aware baseline 解释为特例的部分；3）主实验表和 regularization 消融；4）GenEval 结果，用来判断 reward hacking 风险。预计 20–30 分钟可以把主要思想看明白。若关心 diffusion LM / non-AR LM 的 RL 后训练，可以再细读理论推导，看这种 weighted denoising / weighted regression 是否能迁移到离散生成场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to do RL-style post-training for rectified flow models without going through reverse-process policy gradients. Existing methods such as Flow-GRPO treat denoising as a sequential decision process, but that creates two awkward issues: the native sampler is a deterministic ODE, so extra stochasticity must be injected just to define policy gradients; and rewards are only available on the final image, making credit assignment across denoising steps difficult. AdvantageFlow avoids both by staying in the forward training view. It turns the standard clean-image prediction objective into an advantage-weighted least-squares problem, using within-prompt relative rewards to bias learning toward better samples while adding rollout regularization to stabilize optimization under negative advantages.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper for LLMs, and its direct impact on language-model pretraining is limited. Its value is more conceptual. First, it shows a broader pattern: for generative models trained with denoising or flow-matching objectives, post-training does not have to be framed as token-level or step-level policy gradient. One can often stay close to the original supervised objective and only change sample weighting. Second, the paper derives reward optimization from a local target-distribution fitting view and interprets regularization as both variance reduction and convexity repair. That perspective is relevant to diffusion LMs, masked generative models, and other non-AR paradigms where post-training may be easier to express as weighted regression than as trajectory RL.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method starts from the rectified-flow prediction objective for the clean image predictor f_theta(x_t, t, c), where x_t is a linear interpolation between a clean image x_0 and Gaussian noise. Standard training minimizes E||f_theta(x_t,t,c)-x_0||^2. AdvantageFlow replaces this with an advantage-weighted version so that higher-reward samples receive larger positive influence and lower-reward samples receive negative influence relative to the prompt-level batch average.

The main technical difficulty is that advantages can be negative. Naively using signed weights makes the per-sample least-squares objective non-convex and unstable. The paper addresses this with rollout policy regularization. Instead of directly fitting noisy signed targets, it introduces a reward-independent reference induced by a moving-average rollout policy. The derivation is framed as fitting a locally reward-improving target distribution, i.e., a linearly tilted distribution around the current policy that shifts mass toward better samples. The regularization term emerges naturally when replacing noisy sampled targets with their conditional means in the reward-independent part of the objective. This reduces variance and restores strict convexity at the sample level.

An additional useful point is unification. The paper shows that a recent negative-aware forward-process RL baseline can be recovered as a special case under a particular adaptive regularization choice. So the contribution is not only a new algorithm, but also a cleaner objective-level view that organizes several forward-process RL heuristics under one framework.

Compared with reverse-process RL, the difference is structural: no stochastic sampler is required for gradient estimation, no denoising-step credit assignment is needed, and the optimized loss remains the same type of forward prediction loss used in pretraining, only reweighted by reward-derived statistics. In practice this makes the method look closer to supervised fine-tuning than to conventional RL.
summary_en.experiments:
Experiments are built on Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium for text-to-image reward optimization. The main comparisons are against Flow-GRPO on the reverse-process side and a negative-aware fine-tuning baseline on the forward-process side. The reported result is consistent throughout the paper: AdvantageFlow outperforms both baselines across several reward models and also extends to multi-objective optimization.

The empirical section mainly validates four claims. First, forward-process RL can improve reward without explicit reverse-process credit assignment. Second, rollout regularization is not just a training trick; it is central to both stability and final quality, especially when negative advantages are common. Third, gains are not purely reward-model overfitting: the paper includes GenEval as an external check against reward hacking. Fourth, the unifying view is meaningful in practice, since different regularization choices explain the behavior of prior forward-process baselines.

What is missing, from a pretraining-research perspective, is large-scale scaling analysis. The paper does not focus on model-size scaling, token budgets, or training-dynamics diagnostics in the style of LLM pretraining work. It is primarily an algorithm paper centered on objective design and optimization stability.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the Introduction and Algorithm sections. The key question is why reverse-process RL is awkward for flow models and why forward-process weighted regression is a more natural alternative. Then read the derivation of the advantage-weighted least-squares objective from the local reward-improving target distribution. The most important technical point is the role of rollout regularization: it is doing two jobs at once, variance reduction and repair of the non-convexity caused by negative advantages.

If reading time is limited, focus on: (1) the discussion of why negative advantages break naive weighted least squares; (2) the section showing how negative-aware fine-tuning appears as a special case; (3) the main result tables and regularization ablations; and (4) the GenEval results, which are the main sanity check against reward hacking. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough for a solid skim. If your interest is diffusion LM or non-AR LM post-training, the derivation is the part worth reading carefully.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和稳定性推导即可；它对 diffusion LM 的 RL 训练有可迁移信号，结果数字要等正文细看。
recommendation.en: Read the method and stability argument; it offers transferable signal for RL on diffusion LMs, while the empirical strength needs the full tables.

paper.title: Everything at Every Scale: Scale-Invariant Diffusion with Continuous Super-Resolution
paper.abstract: Creating images from noise is image generation; reconstructing fine details from coarse inputs is super-resolution. Despite their practical differences, both can be understood as reversing information loss across scales. We introduce $\textbf{SKILD}$, a $\textbf{S}$cale-invariant $\textbf{K}$-Space $\textbf{I}$mage $\textbf{L}$earning $\textbf{D}$iffusion model that unifies generation and continuous super-resolution within a single unconditional framework. summary.core_problem: 把无条件图像生成和连续倍率超分辨率统一为同一个跨尺度反向扩散过程。
summary.importance: 贡献是图像扩散建模中的 forward process 设计：把尺度作为扩散动态的显式坐标，用一个模型覆盖从生成到超分辨率的不同起点。对 LLM 预训练不是直接相关，但对 diffusion/flow 类生成范式的噪声过程设计有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: SKILD 在 k-space 中构造 scale-invariant diffusion：前向过程从细到粗衰减图像内容，同时注入与频谱匹配的高斯噪声。训练后的同一个反向过程根据起始 timestep 的不同执行无条件生成或连续超分辨率，不需要任务专用架构、conditioning branch、classifier-free guidance，也不需要为不同放大倍率重训。
summary.experiments: 摘要称该框架在自然图像和临界物理系统的尺度不变性假设下工作，并展示 generation 与 continuous super-resolution 的统一能力。未给出具体数据集、模型规模、baseline 数字或提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: William T. Freeman 和 Marin Soljačić 是 MIT 相关方向的知名研究者，长期涉及计算视觉、物理启发学习和生成建模。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper unifies unconditional image generation and continuous super-resolution as the reversal of scale-dependent information loss.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a diffusion forward-process design for image generation: scale becomes an explicit coordinate of the dynamics, allowing one model to cover generation and super-resolution from different starting timesteps. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to noise-process design in diffusion and flow-style generative modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: SKILD defines a scale-invariant k-space diffusion process that attenuates image content from fine to coarse scales while injecting spectrum-matched Gaussian noise. The same learned reverse process performs either unconditional generation or continuous super-resolution by changing only the starting timestep, without task-specific heads, conditioning branches, classifier-free guidance, or per-scale retraining.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports demonstrations on natural images and critical physical systems, motivated by scale invariance in both domains. It does not provide dataset details, model scale, baseline tables, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: William T. Freeman and Marin Soljačić are well-known MIT researchers associated with computational vision, physics-inspired learning, and generative modeling.

recommendation.zh: 不必精读结果表，重点看 forward process；把尺度写进噪声动态这点，可迁移思考到离散扩散 LM。
recommendation.en: Do not spend time on the result tables; inspect the forward process, since encoding scale into the noise dynamics may transfer to discrete diffusion LMs.

paper.title: Geometry-Aware Image Flow Matching
paper.abstract: Recent advances in generative models highlight the power of geometry-aware modeling in manifold-constrained settings. Yet, for natural images, the field remains confined to Euclidean assumptions, failing to exploit the potential of intrinsic geometric structures within the data. In this work, we investigate the geometry of natural images and observe that semantic information is predominantly encoded in directional components, while norm components can be approximated by the global average. This

summary.core_problem: 现有图像 flow matching 多在欧氏空间建模，可能忽略自然图像在方向和范数上的内在几何结构。
summary.importance: 这是图像生成中的几何建模工作。它的价值不在 LLM 直接应用，而在于提出自然图像可在 hypersphere 上建模的经验观察，并把该观察用于 flow matching 目标设计。
summary.technical_approach: 作者观察到语义信息主要存在于方向分量，范数分量可由全局平均近似；这一性质在 RGB 和 latent space 中都成立。基于此提出 Spherical Optimal Transport Flow Matching，使用 angular distance；以及 Spherical Flow Matching，直接约束动力学在球面流形上。
summary.experiments: 摘要称几何感知方法优于欧氏 baseline，但未给出数据集、模型规模、FID 或其他指标数值。实验覆盖 RGB 与 latent space 的图像表示几何分析，并比较球面 flow matching 与欧氏 flow matching。

summary_en.core_problem: Most image flow matching methods operate in Euclidean space, which may ignore intrinsic geometry in natural image representations.
summary_en.importance: This is a geometry-aware image generation paper. Its relevance to base-model research is indirect: it proposes that natural images can be modeled on a hypersphere and modifies flow matching objectives accordingly.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors observe that semantic information is mostly encoded in directional components, while norm components can be approximated by a global average. They introduce Spherical Optimal Transport Flow Matching with angular distance and Spherical Flow Matching with dynamics constrained to the spherical manifold.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that the geometry-aware methods outperform Euclidean baselines, but does not provide dataset names, model sizes, or metric values. The experiments analyze both RGB and latent spaces and compare spherical versus Euclidean flow matching.

recommendation.zh: 作为生成建模几何假设备查即可；若没有大规模 latent diffusion 验证，不必投入太多阅读时间。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference on geometric assumptions in generative modeling; without large-scale latent diffusion evidence, it is not a deep read.

paper.title: Reinforcing Few-step Generators via Reward-Tilted Distribution Matching

We propose Reward-Tilted Distribution Matching Distillation (RTDMD), a two-stage framework that unifies distribution matching distillation with reward-guided reinforcement learning for few-step flow generators. We show that minimizing the KL divergence to a reward-tilted teacher distribution naturally decomposes into a distribution matc

summary.core_problem: 解决少步 diffusion/flow 生成器在蒸馏后生成很快但难以再按人类偏好对齐的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是图像生成模型的奖励对齐和蒸馏方法改进。它不属于 LLM 预训练，但把 distribution matching distillation 与 reward-guided RL 放在同一个 KL 目标下推导，对理解生成模型对齐目标有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Reward-Tilted Distribution Matching Distillation。核心是把到 reward-tilted teacher distribution 的 KL 最小化分解为 distribution matching 项和 reward maximization 项。第一阶段 AC-DMD 做子区间级分布匹配，并用 consistency regularizer 稳定 fake score model，使其跟踪有限更新下不断移动的 generator distribution。第二阶段联合优化分布匹配和奖励项，奖励部分推导了结合 GRPO 风格信号的 hybrid policy gradient。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明方法面向 few-step flow generators，并与现有少步 diffusion distillation 和偏好对齐方法比较；提供文本未包含具体模型、数据集、奖励模型、步数、FID/CLIP/人评结果或提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology 与 Westlake University；Tianyu Pang 近年有生成模型、鲁棒性和对齐相关工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses preference alignment for few-step diffusion or flow generators, where fast distilled models are hard to further optimize toward human rewards.
summary_en.importance: This is a method contribution for image generation alignment and distillation. It is not LLM pretraining, but the derivation linking distribution matching and reward optimization under a single KL objective is relevant for thinking about generative-model alignment losses.
summary_en.technical_approach: RTDMD minimizes KL to a reward-tilted teacher distribution and decomposes the objective into a distribution-matching term and a reward-maximization term. Stage one introduces AC-DMD with subinterval-wise distribution matching and a consistency regularizer for the fake score model. Stage two jointly optimizes matching and reward, using a hybrid policy-gradient estimator that incorporates GRPO-style signals.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract positions the method for few-step flow generators and compares against existing diffusion distillation and reward-alignment approaches, but the provided text does not include concrete model sizes, datasets, reward models, sampling steps, or metric gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology and Westlake University. Tianyu Pang has worked on generative models, robustness, and alignment-related methods.

recommendation.zh: 读目标函数推导即可；把 DMD 和奖励倾斜写成同一 KL，比图像实验本身更值得记。
recommendation.en: Read the objective derivation only; the useful part is casting DMD and reward tilting under one KL, not the image results.

paper.title: GenEvolve: Self-Evolving Image Generation Agents via Tool-Orchestrated Visual Experience Distillation

High-quality generation often requires an agent to combine a model's internal generative ability with external resources. As requests become more diverse and demanding, we aim to develop a general image-generation agent that can self-evolve through trajectories and use tools more effectively across varied generation challenges. To this end, we propose GenEvolve, a self-evolving framework based on Tool-Orchestrated Visual

summary.core_problem: 面向开放式图像生成请求，研究如何让图像生成 agent 从多次工具调用轨迹中自我改进，而不是只依赖单次 prompt-to-image 生成。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏方法组合：把图像生成建模为工具编排轨迹，并用轨迹间的优劣差异蒸馏可复用的视觉经验。对 LLM 预训练研究的直接价值有限，但对 agentic data distillation 和多模态生成后训练有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: GenEvolve 将每次生成尝试表示为 tool-orchestrated trajectory，包含证据收集、参考图选择、生成技能调用和 prompt-reference program 组合。与只用图像级标量 reward 的方法不同，它比较同一请求下多条轨迹的 best-worst 差异，并抽象成结构化 visual experience，再提供给 privileged teacher 做经验蒸馏。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露模型规模、训练数据规模和具体提升幅度。实验目标应是多样化图像生成挑战下的工具使用质量、生成质量和泛化表现，对比对象包括现有 agentic image generation 或 reward-based generation 方法。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港科技大学（广州）、美团、香港科技大学和新加坡国立大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles open-ended image generation where an agent must improve its tool-use trajectories rather than rely on a single prompt-to-image call.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly a method-level design: image generation is treated as tool-orchestrated trajectories, and reusable visual experience is distilled from best-worst trajectory comparisons. It is only indirectly relevant to LLM pretraining, but it may inform agentic data distillation for multimodal generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: GenEvolve represents each generation attempt as a trajectory involving evidence gathering, reference selection, generation-skill invocation, and prompt-reference program composition. Instead of using only scalar image-level rewards, it compares multiple trajectories for the same request, abstracts their best-worst differences into structured visual experience, and feeds that experience to a privileged teacher.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, data scale, or numerical gains. The evaluation appears to cover diverse image-generation challenges, tool-use quality, generation quality, and generalization against existing agentic or reward-based generation methods.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from HKUST Guangzhou, Meituan, HKUST, and the National University of Singapore.

recommendation.en: Treat it as trajectory distillation for image generation; low pretraining value, but the experience abstraction format is worth a quick look.

paper.title: Guided Trajectory Optimization with Sparse Scaling for Test-Time Diffusion
paper.abstract: The efficient Test-Time Scaling (TTS) paradigm offers a promising perspective for enhancing the generation performance of diffusion models. However, current solutions are limited to a static, pre-defined noise pool and suffer from inflexible noise exploration across the denoising trajectory. To bridge this gap, we propose RTS, a novel Reward-guided Trajectory Scaling method to fully unlock the generative potential of diffusion models. Unlike existing methods, RTS facilitates the synthesis of ref

summary.core_problem: 提升扩散图像生成模型的 test-time scaling 效率和效果，避免固定噪声池带来的搜索僵化。
summary.importance: 贡献是图像扩散模型推理期搜索方法。它不是语言建模工作，但 reward-guided test-time compute allocation 对理解生成模型的推理期扩展有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: RTS 提出 Reward-guided Trajectory Scaling：一方面用 reward signal 优化噪声，使搜索主动朝高质量样本区域移动；另一方面用 sparse test-time scaling 只在关键 denoising step 上投入额外搜索。PCA-driven curvature analysis 用来识别轨迹中更值得扩展的中间步骤，从而压缩搜索空间。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 RTS 在 GenEval Score 上相对 baseline 提升 15.6%，ImageReward 分数提升 60.4%。未从摘要中看到模型规模、采样预算、reward model 细节和完整 baseline 设置。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Guangdong University of Technology、South China University of Technology 和 Nanyang Technological University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper improves test-time scaling for diffusion image generation by replacing static noise-pool exploration with guided trajectory optimization.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time search method for image diffusion models. It is not language modeling, but its reward-guided compute allocation is a useful analogy for test-time scaling in generative systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: RTS introduces Reward-guided Trajectory Scaling. It optimizes noise using reward feedback to steer sampling toward promising regions, and applies sparse test-time scaling only at selected denoising steps. A PCA-driven curvature analysis identifies important intermediate steps and reduces the search space.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a 15.6% improvement in GenEval Score and a 60.4% improvement in ImageReward over baselines. Model scale, sampling budget, reward-model setup, and full baseline details are not visible from the provided abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Guangdong University of Technology, South China University of Technology, and Nanyang Technological University.

recommendation.zh: 作为扩散版 inference scaling 旁证即可；若采样预算未严格对齐，60% ImageReward 提升要打折看。
recommendation.en: Treat it as an image-diffusion analogue of inference scaling; if sampling budgets are not tightly controlled, the 60% ImageReward gain should be discounted.

paper.title: DecQ: Detail-Condensing Queries for Enhanced Reconstruction and Generation in Representation Autoencoders
paper.abstract: Representation Autoencoders (RAEs) leverage frozen vision foundation models (VFMs) as tokenizer encoders, providing robust high-level representations that facilitate fast convergence and high-quality generation in latent diffusion models. However, freezing the VFM inherently constrains its spatial reconstruction capacity, limiting fine-grained generation and image editing; in contrast, incorporating reconstruction-oriented signals via fine-tuning disrupts the pretrained semantic space and degrad

summary.core_problem: 在使用冻结的视觉基础模型（VFM）作为 tokenizer encoder 的 Representation Autoencoder（RAE）范式里，如何同时获得高语义一致性（不破坏预训练表征空间）与高重建保真度（保留颜色/纹理等低层细节），并避免“重建更好→生成更差”的系统性权衡。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接关联在“统一建模/Tokenizer”这一侧：它讨论的是视觉 tokenizer 如何在不改动大模型表征空间的前提下补足细节信息，并且把这种补足方式显式纳入生成模型的建模目标。虽然论文场景是视觉 latent diffusion/flow matching，而不是纯文本 LLM，但对多模态统一预训练里“离散/连续视觉表征如何既语义稳定又可逆”的问题有可迁移的设计思路：用小容量、可控的旁路通道承载细节，而不是去微调大 encoder 或粗暴拼接特征导致语义空间漂移。
summary.technical_approach:
DecQ 在冻结 VFM 的前提下，引入一组轻量的 detail-condensing queries（可学习查询向量）作为“细节旁路”。核心做法是：
- 冻结的 VFM encoder 仍输出语义主干表征（高层、对增强不敏感）。
- 额外引入少量 learnable queries，通过 cross-attention 去读取 VFM 的中间层特征；这些 queries 经过 condenser modules，把中间层里更接近像素/纹理的细节压缩成一小组 token。
- tokenizer 训练阶段：只训练 decoder 与这些查询/凝聚模块，用重建相关损失（L1、LPIPS、GAN 等，沿用 RAE 设定）让 queries 学会携带“VFM 主干表征缺失的细节”。因为 VFM 参数不动，语义空间不被扰动。
- 生成阶段的关键点：不仅在 latent 空间对图像 patch token 做生成/去噪（RAE 里用 flow matching / diffusion transformer 预测 velocity），还把这些 detail queries 作为生成变量一起建模（joint denoising）。论文的经验结论是：让生成模型也预测这些 queries，会反过来提升生成质量，从而缓解“重建–生成”权衡。
- 层级选择的观察：浅层特征凝聚更利于重建（细节/纹理），深层特征凝聚更利于生成（语义/结构）；同时用浅+深能兼顾两者。
对比基线：VFM-finetune（解冻 encoder）、VFM-distill（加语义蒸馏保持输出）、VFM-feat-concat（拼接特征补细节）都会出现一致的 trade-off；DecQ 试图用“冻结主干 + 小旁路 + 联合建模”绕开冲突目标。
summary.experiments:
论文在统一设置下比较多种 VFM-based tokenizer：使用 DiT DH-S 作为生成模型，在 ImageNet 256×256 上训练 80 epochs。作者声称：
- 以冻结 VFM 的 RAE 为基线，DecQ 在提升重建细节（减少纹理丢失、颜色漂移等伪影）的同时，生成质量也稳定提升，并保持较快收敛。
- 消融结论集中在两点：浅层 queries 更偏重建、深层 queries 更偏生成；联合使用效果最好。
（你提供的全文片段未包含具体指标数值，如 FID、重建误差、收敛速度曲线的定量提升幅度；若需要精确数字，需要查看实验章节的表格/曲线。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议按“问题—对照—机制”顺序：
- 先看引言里对 RAE 的 objective mismatch 与三类对照方案（finetune/distill/feat-concat）在统一训练设定下的 trade-off 现象，这是动机的证据链。
- 方法部分重点看：queries 如何从哪些 VFM 层取特征、condenser module 的结构、queries 数量与计算开销、以及生成阶段为何要 joint denoising。
- 实验部分优先找：层级消融（shallow vs deep）、queries 数量/位置的敏感性、以及“重建提升但生成不降反升”的关键对比图表。
预计阅读时间：30–40 分钟可掌握方法与主要结论；若你在做多模态 tokenizer/统一预训练，建议再花 30 分钟细读消融与训练细节。

summary_en.core_problem: In representation autoencoders that use a frozen vision foundation model (VFM) as the tokenizer encoder, how can we recover fine-grained reconstructability (color/texture/detail) without fine-tuning the VFM and drifting its pretrained semantic space—while also avoiding the recurring reconstruction–generation trade-off observed in prior variants?
summary_en.importance: The direct connection to foundation-model research is on the tokenizer/representation side: it proposes a controlled way to add “detail capacity” to a frozen semantic encoder via a small auxiliary channel, and it explicitly integrates that channel into the generative modeling objective. While the paper is framed around latent diffusion/flow-matching image generation, the design pattern is relevant to multimodal pretraining where you want a stable semantic backbone plus an invertible/faithful representation for generation and editing, without destabilizing the pretrained encoder.
summary_en.technical_approach:
DecQ keeps the VFM encoder frozen and introduces a small set of learnable detail-condensing queries as an auxiliary pathway.
- The frozen VFM provides the main semantic latent tokens.
- A handful of learnable queries attend (cross-attention) to intermediate VFM features and pass through condenser modules to compress low-level information into a compact set of “detail tokens”.
- Tokenizer training updates only the decoder and the query/condenser components, using reconstruction-oriented losses (L1, perceptual/LPIPS, adversarial/GAN as in RAE setups). Because the VFM is frozen, the pretrained semantic space is preserved.
- Generation-time integration: the diffusion/flow-matching transformer is trained to jointly denoise/predict both image patch latents and the detail queries. Empirically, modeling the queries as part of the generative state improves generation quality rather than merely improving reconstruction.
- Layer-selection insight: condensing from shallow VFM layers mainly helps reconstruction; condensing from deeper layers helps generation; combining both yields the best balance.
The paper positions this against common alternatives (unfreezing, distillation-regularized tuning, feature concatenation), which tend to show a consistent trade-off between better reconstruction and worse generation.
summary_en.experiments:
Experiments are run under a unified setup: DiT DH-S as the generator, ImageNet 256×256, 80 training epochs, comparing multiple VFM-based tokenizer paradigms. Reported qualitative findings: DecQ reduces reconstruction artifacts (texture loss, color shifts) over the frozen-VFM baseline and simultaneously improves generative performance and convergence behavior.
Ablations emphasize (i) shallow vs deep feature sources for queries and (ii) combining both sources.
(The provided excerpt does not include the exact quantitative metrics—e.g., FID or reconstruction scores—so precise deltas require checking the experiment tables/plots in the full paper.)
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in this order: (1) the motivation section showing the reconstruction–generation trade-off under a controlled training setup across baselines; (2) the method details on how queries read intermediate VFM layers and how the condenser is implemented; (3) the generation section explaining joint denoising of queries with patch latents; (4) ablations on which layers to condense from and how many queries to use. 30–40 minutes to grasp the core idea; add another ~30 minutes if you care about tokenizer design choices and training stability/overhead.

recommendation.zh: 读方法图和重建/生成消融；它给视觉 tokenizer 一个干净折中，但指标缺失时先别上升到范式判断。
recommendation.en: Read the method figure and reconstruction/generation ablations; it is a clean visual-tokenizer compromise, but do not overread it without the metric tables.
